subject: english

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ my grandparents during the holidays.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: during the holidays 指刚过去的假期，用一般过去时，visit 的过去式是 visited。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What did you do last Sunday?  — I ___ to the park.
questions.explanation: 问句用了 did，回答也要用过去式，go 的过去式是 went。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Where ___ you go last summer?  — I ___ to Hainan.
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句用 did 提问、动词回原形；回答要用过去式，所以第二空是 went。“did; go”错在回答没有用过去式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Last Sunday I ___ a film and ___ a book.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: see 和 buy 都是不规则动词：see—saw—seen，buy—bought—bought。两个空都要用过去式，seen 是过去分词，不能单独作谓语。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是一般过去时（  ）
options: I will visit my uncle tomorrow.
I visit my uncle every week.
I am visiting my uncle now.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是过去的时间，动词用过去式 visited。every week 配一般现在时，now 配现在进行时，tomorrow 配将来时。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面句子中，动词过去式写错的一项是（  ）
questions.explanation: go 是不规则动词，过去式是 went，不能加 -ed。“goed”是孩子最常写错的形状之一。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last summer I went to Beijing with my parents. We visited the Great Wall.” 这句话说的是（  ）
options: 今年夏天“我”和父母要去北京，一起去爬长城
“我”一个人去了北京，没有和父母一起去
“我”每天都要去长城走一走，不去别的地方
去年夏天“我”和父母去了北京，参观了长城
questions.explanation: last summer 是去年夏天，went 和 visited 都是过去式——整句都在讲已经发生的事，不是计划。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读对话：“— Did you go swimming yesterday? — No, I didn't. I stayed at home and read a book.” 从回答看，“我”昨天（  ）
options: 在家睡了一整天，什么也没做
待在家里看书，没有去游泳
和同学一起去游泳了，玩得很开心
去图书馆借书，一整天都没回家
questions.explanation: No, I didn't 是否定回答，后面 stayed（待在家里）和 read（读书）才是实际做的事。回答里的动词全是过去式。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom usually gets up at six, but yesterday he got up at eight.” 这句话告诉我们（  ）
options: 汤姆昨天六点就起床了，比平时还早
汤姆昨天一直睡到中午，根本没有起床
汤姆平时六点起床，昨天八点才起
汤姆每天都是八点起床，从来没早过
questions.explanation: usually 配一般现在时 gets，yesterday 配过去式 got——两个时间对两种时态，这是英语里最要紧的一条线。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We ___ a lot of photos in the park last Sunday.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: last Sunday 是过去的时间，拍照要用过去式。take 的过去式是不规则变化 took；take 是原形，takes 是第三人称单数，taken 是过去分词，不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It ___ sunny during the holidays.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: during the holidays 指已经过去的假期，要用过去式。主语 It 是单数，be 动词用 was；were 用于复数或 you，are 是现在时，been 是过去分词，都不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Did you ___ your homework last night? — Yes, I did.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: Did 开头的疑问句里，动词要用原形，所以填 finish。finished 本身是过去式，不能再跟在 did 后面；finishing 不能作谓语；finishes 是第三人称单数形式，和 you 不搭。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把 “I go to school by bus every day.” 改成昨天发生的事，正确的一项是（  ）
options: Yesterday I go to school by bus.
Yesterday I went to school by bus.
Yesterday I goed to school by bus.
Yesterday I am going to school by bus.
questions.explanation: yesterday 要求动词用过去式，go 的过去式是 went。保留 go 没有改时态；goed 是错误拼写，go 属不规则动词；am going 是现在进行时，不能和 yesterday 搭配。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想问同学假期里做了什么，最恰当的一句是（  ）
options: What do you did during the holidays?
What did you during the holidays?
What did you do during the holidays?
What are you doing during the holidays?
questions.explanation: 问过去做了什么，要用 What did you do... 的句式，did 后面跟动词原形 do。第二项把 do 又变成 did，重复了过去式；第三项缺了实义动词 do，句子不完整；第四项是现在进行时，问的是正在做的事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Did you have a good time in the park? — ___（选择最恰当的答语）
options: Yes, we did had a great time.
Yes, we have a great time.
Yes, we are having a great time.
Yes, we had a great time.
questions.explanation: 问句用 Did 问过去的事，肯定回答要用过去式 had。did 后面不能再接过去式 had；have 是现在时，和过去的问题不符；are having 是现在进行时，也没有回答过去的事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个词是 go 的过去式（  ）
questions.explanation: go 的变化是 go—went—gone，过去式是 went。goes 是第三人称单数形式；going 是现在分词；gone 是过去分词，常和 have 连用，不是过去式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组动词的过去式都是不规则变化（  ）
questions.explanation: go 和 see 的过去式 went、saw 都不是加 -ed 得来的，属于不规则变化。其余三组里的 play、watch、visit、clean、help、cook 都是直接加 -ed，属于规则变化。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的时间词和动词形式不搭配（  ）
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，动词要用过去式，不能用原形 visit，所以这一句不搭配。其余选项都用了一般过去式，和句中的过去时间一致。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Did you see the film last night? 下面哪个答语正确（  ）
questions.explanation: Did 问的是过去的事，否定回答用 didn't，后面不再跟动词。don't 是现在时；didn't 后面又加 saw，重复了过去式；wasn't 是 be 动词的否定，不能回答用 did 提问的句子。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句既表达了“去年夏天我去了北京”，动词形式又正确（  ）
options: I go to Beijing last summer.
I went to Beijing next summer.
I went to Beijing last summer.
I am going to Beijing last summer.
questions.explanation: “去年夏天”要用过去式 went，时间词 last summer 也要对得上。go 是原形，时态不对；next summer 指明年夏天，和“去年”矛盾；am going 是现在进行时，同样不能配 last summer。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “— Where did you go last summer? — I go to Hainan.” 这句答语错在哪里（  ）
options: 问句该用 do，却用了 did
答语该用 went，却用了 go
时间词要改成 next summer
questions.explanation: 问句用 did 问去年夏天，答语也要用过去式，go 应改成 went。问句里的 did 用得对；go to Hainan 搭配正确；last summer 和问句一致，不需要改。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last Sunday I went to the zoo with my sister. We saw pandas and monkeys.” 从句子看，他们去了哪里（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子里的 zoo 就是动物园，还提到看到了熊猫和猴子。公园、学校、图书馆在句子里都没有出现。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“During the holidays, Lily visited her grandma and helped her cook.” 从句子看，Lily 假期里做了什么（  ）
questions.explanation: visited her grandma 是看望奶奶，helped her cook 是帮她做饭，合起来就是答案。去北京、去公园跑步、看动画片，句子里都没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Amy went to the park last Saturday. It rained in the afternoon, so she went home.” 从句子看，Amy 为什么回家（  ）
questions.explanation: so 前面说 It rained，说明下雨是她提早回家的原因。累了、公园关门、要做作业这三个原因，句子里都没有依据。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I had eggs and milk for breakfast, then I walked to school.” 从句子看，他先做了什么（  ）
questions.explanation: then 前面的 had eggs and milk for breakfast 是先发生的事，then 后面的 walked to school 是后发生的事。其余选项把顺序倒过来，或换成了句子里没有的活动。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Peter planned to swim last Sunday. But it was cold, so he stayed at home.” 从句子看，Peter 上周日（  ）
questions.explanation: planned 只是原计划，But 说明计划没实现：天冷，所以他待在家里。去游泳、踢足球、去上课都和 stayed at home 矛盾。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Mike usually walks to school, but last Monday he went by bus because he got up late.” 从句子看，Mike 那天早上（  ）
options: 起得很早，所以走去学校
questions.explanation: because he got up late 说明他起晚了，所以改坐公交车。走路是他平时的做法；脚受伤、下雨，句子里都没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “去游泳”的英文是（  ）
questions.explanation: go + doing 表示去做某项活动：go swimming、go fishing、go shopping。动词要用 -ing 形式，不加 to。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What did you do during the holidays?  — I ___ my grandparents in the countryside.
questions.explanation: 问句用 did 提问，回答要用过去式 visited。during the holidays 指的是刚过去的那个假期。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Last week we ___ a picnic and ___ many photos.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: have—had—had，take—took—taken。两个空都是谓语，要用过去式；taken 是过去分词，不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My hometown is a small village near the river. There are many trees and a big lake.” 这段话说的是（  ）
options: “我”的家乡是河边的小村庄，有很多树和一个大湖
“我”住在一座很大的城市里，高楼很多，车也很多
“我”的家乡没有水，村里人喝水都很困难
“我”的家乡在一座很高的山上，山下没有河也没有湖
questions.explanation: village 是村庄，near the river 在河边，lake 是湖。按词找信息，不要凭“家乡”两个字想当然。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I went to Shanghai with my family. We visited the Bund and ate delicious food. We had a great time.” 这段话主要讲（  ）
options: “我”没有去上海，一直待在家里
“我”和家人去上海，玩得很开心
“我”一个人去了上海，没有带家人
“我”在上海吃的东西不好吃，很失望
questions.explanation: 三句分别是地点、活动、感受，合起来就是“去了上海、玩得开心”。主要意思看整体，不能只盯一个词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I went back to my hometown. It is a small town, but it is much more beautiful than before.” 从这句可以知道（  ）
options: 家乡是个小镇，现在比以前漂亮多了
家乡是个很大的城市，人口比镇上多得多
家乡和以前一模一样，一点变化也没有
说话人假期没有回家乡，一直留在学校
questions.explanation: went back 是“回去了”，but 之后才是重点：small town，而且 more beautiful than before——转折词后面常是说话人真正想说的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组全是“假期活动”的短语（  ）
options: go swimming / visit grandparents / take photos
get up / brush teeth / go to bed
questions.explanation: 第二组是每天起床睡觉的作息，第三组是星期，第四组是颜色——只有第一组是假期里做的事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What did you do during the holidays?  下面回答最恰当的一项是（  ）
options: Yes, I did, but the weather was very hot that day.
It is Monday today, so we have to go to school early.
I visited my grandparents and read some books.
I am a student in Grade Six, and I like English very much.
questions.explanation: 问“做了什么”，就要答做过的事，动词用过去式。答“我是学生”答非所问；Yes, I did 只能回答一般疑问句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 对话中有一处不当：“— Where did you go last week? — I go to Beijing. — Did you have a good time? — Yes, I did.” 不当之处是（  ）
options: 第二句的 go 应改成 went
第一句中的 did 应该改成 do
第三句的 Did 应改成 Do
第四句的 did 应改成 do
questions.explanation: 问和答都要用过去时：问句用了 did go，答句就该用 went。一处时态没跟上，整段对话就错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要向同学介绍自己的假期，下面开头最合适的一项是（  ）
options: During the holidays, I went to my hometown with my parents.
I am a student in Grade Six, and I go to school by bus every day.
My name is Li Ming, and I am twelve years old this year.
Holidays are very good, and I like holidays very much.
questions.explanation: 介绍假期，第一句就该说清“什么时候、和谁、去了哪里”。只报姓名、只说“假期很好”，都还没进正题。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 说“我假期过得很开心”，下面表达最完整、最自然的一项是（  ）
options: I am happy during the holidays.
I had a great time during the holidays. I visited my grandparents and we went fishing together.
questions.explanation: 英语里“过得开心”说 have a good/great time，时态用过去式；只说 happy 缺动词，句子立不起来。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要把假期的三件事说成一段连贯的话，下面顺序最合理的一项是（  ）
options: 只说自己的感受，去了哪里、做了什么一句都不说
把三件事倒着说一遍，先讲结果再讲开头
先说去了哪里，再说做了什么，最后说感受
先说感受，再说去了哪里，最后说做了什么
questions.explanation: 英语叙事也讲顺序：地点、活动、感受。先讲感受，听话的人还不知道你在说哪一段经历。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 单词 hometown 的意思是（  ）
questions.explanation: hometown 指一个人出生、长大的地方，意思是“家乡”。城市是 city，村庄是 village，海边是 beach。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 短语 have a picnic 的意思是（  ）
questions.explanation: have a picnic 是“进行野餐”，picnic 本身就是野餐。爬山是 climb a hill，拍照是 take photos，参观是 visit。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It was hot. We went to the beach and ___ in the sea.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 前一句 It was hot 和 went 都是过去，and 连接的两件事时态要一致，所以用 went swimming。go 和 goes 是现在时，going 不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想告诉同学你假期去乡下看望了爷爷奶奶，下面哪句最合适？
options: I visited my grandparents in the village.
I visit my grandparents in the city.
I will visit my grandparents tomorrow.
My grandparents live in a small village now.
questions.explanation: 讲已经过去的假期要用过去式 visited，地点是乡下 village。另外几句要么用现在时 visit，要么用将来 will visit，要么只说祖父母住在村里，没有回答“我做了什么”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想告诉同学“假期我们没去海边，在家看书”，下面哪句最合适？
options: We don't go to the beach. We stayed at home and read books.
We didn't go to the beach. We stayed at home and read books.
We didn't go to the beach. We stayed at school and read books.
We went to the beach. We stayed at home and read books.
questions.explanation: 假期是已经过去的事，两个动作都要用过去式：didn't go 和 stayed。用 don't 是现在时；说去了海边与“没去海边”意思相反；把在家换成在学校，也不符合这个情景。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句正确表达“去年暑假我去了北京，参观了博物馆”？
options: I go to Beijing and visit the museum last summer.
I went to Beijing and visit the museum last summer.
I will go to Beijing and visited the museum last summer.
I went to Beijing and visited the museum last summer.
questions.explanation: 去年暑假是过去时间，两个动作都要用过去式：went 和 visited。用 go、visit 是现在时；will go 与 visited 一个将来一个过去，前后不一致。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last Sunday we went to the park. We had a picnic and took photos.” 他们在公园里做了什么？
questions.explanation: 引文里 had a picnic 是野餐，took photos 是拍照。游泳、看书、爬山、参观博物馆这些活动引文都没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Yesterday we visited the museum. We saw many old things there.” 他们昨天去了哪里？
questions.explanation: visited the museum 就是参观博物馆，saw many old things 也说明地点在博物馆。动物园是 zoo，公园是 park，海边是 beach。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We went to the beach. The water was warm, so we swam for a long time.” 他们为什么游了很久？
questions.explanation: 引文用 so 说明原因：水很温暖，所以他们游了很久。天气冷、海滩近、人很累这些原因引文都没有说，也不合逻辑。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My hometown is near the sea. Every summer I go back and swim with my cousins.” 作者的家乡在哪里？
questions.explanation: near the sea 说明家乡在海边，所以夏天能回去游泳。山村在山里，城里是城市，河边在 river 旁边，引文都没有说。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I wanted to go to the zoo, but it rained all day. So I stayed at home and read books.” 可以知道什么？
questions.explanation: but it rained all day 说明下了一整天雨，所以只能待在家里看书，没去成动物园。生病、动物园关门、作业多这些原因引文都没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I visited my grandparents in the village. We picked fruit and had a picnic there.” 下面哪一项与这段话不符？
questions.explanation: 引文说去了 village 看 grandparents，还摘了水果、一起野餐，没有去海边，所以“他去了海边度假”与这段话不符。其余三项都能在引文里找到依据。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个词与其他三个不同类？
questions.explanation: city、town、park 都是表示地点的名词，swim 是表示动作的动词，所以它不同类。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个短语的搭配是正确的？
questions.explanation: “拍照”的固定搭配是 take photos，take 在这里表示“拍摄”。make、do、play 都不能和 photos 这样搭配。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把“We went to the park.”和“We had a picnic.”合成一句，用哪个词连接最合适？
questions.explanation: 去公园和野餐是先后发生的两件事，意思顺接，用 and 连接。but 表转折，or 表选择，so 表结果，都不符合这里的关系。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个活动与地点搭配不当？
options: climb a hill in the village
questions.explanation: 博物馆是参观展品的地方，不能在里面游泳，所以“在博物馆游泳”搭配不当。在公园看书、在海边拍照、在村里爬山都合情合理。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last summer I went to the beach with my family. We swam and ate seafood.” 下面哪一项与这段话不符？
options: We went there with my family.
questions.explanation: 引文说 Last summer，暑假在夏天，而“冬天去那里”与它直接矛盾。在海滩游泳、和家人一起去、在那里吃海鲜，这三项都能从引文找到依据。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My hometown is a small village. I love the clean river and the kind people there.” 作者对家乡的态度是？
questions.explanation: 引文用 love 直接表达了对家乡小河和乡亲的喜爱。想搬去城市、觉得无聊、不喜欢村里人，这些态度引文都没有，而且与 love 相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想向外国朋友介绍“这是我的家乡”，下面哪句最合适？
questions.explanation: 介绍家乡用 hometown 最准确，This is my hometown 就是“这是我的家乡”。city 指城市，village 指村庄，park 指公园，都不能表达“家乡”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想邀请同学周末一起去公园野餐，下面哪句最合适？
options: You must have a picnic in the park with me.
Let's have a picnic in the park this weekend.
We had a picnic in the park last weekend.
Let's having a picnic in the park this weekend.
questions.explanation: Let's 后面跟动词原形，是提出邀请、商量的说法，最自然。用 must 是命令，不像邀请；说上周末野餐是讲过去的事，没有发出邀请；Let's 后面要用 have，不能用 having。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 向同学介绍自己的家乡，下面哪一句最得体（  ）
options: My hometown is a beautiful small village.
My hometown is poor and a little ugly, I think.
My hometown is much better and nicer than yours.
I don't know where my hometown is, so I can't say.
questions.explanation: 介绍家乡要说清它是什么样子，beautiful small village 既明白又亲切。说自己家乡穷、不好看，或拿来和别人比高低，都不够得体；说不知道家乡在哪里也不是介绍。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学问“Where did you go last summer?”，下面回答最合适的是？
options: I went back to my hometown.
I go back to my hometown every year.
I went there with my parents.
It is a small village near the river.
questions.explanation: 问的是去年夏天去了哪里，要直接说出地点，并用过去式 went。说每年都回去是讲习惯，时态与问句不符；说和父母一起去、说村子在河边，都没有回答“去了哪里”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last week I went back to my hometown. I helped my grandparents pick fruit.” 下面哪一句接在后面最连贯？
options: I will help them next week.
My hometown is a big city.
questions.explanation: 引文用过去式讲回家乡帮爷爷奶奶摘水果，再接一句“我们在一起很开心”，也是过去式，顺着事情的结果说，最连贯。说下周要去帮忙是将来，与前面的过去不一致；说家乡是大城市、说她很喜欢苹果，都接不上摘水果这件事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学问你假期去了哪里，你其实一直待在家里，下面回答最得体的是（  ）
options: I went nowhere, and I felt really bored.
You will never know where I went.
I stayed at home and read books.
I won't tell you, so stop asking me.
questions.explanation: 如实说出在家的活动，既回答了问题，又显得假期过得充实。说“很无聊”带着抱怨，说“你永远不会知道”“别问了”会让人觉得不友好。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: He ___ to school by bike every day.
questions.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，every day 表示习惯，动词加 -es：goes。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister ___ her homework after dinner.
questions.explanation: My sister 是第三人称单数，do 要变成 does。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My father ___ TV in the evening, but my parents ___ TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: my father 是单数用 watches，my parents 是复数用 watch。同一句话里两个主语形式不同。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My brother ___ English every evening, and he ___ English films on Sundays.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空的主语都是 he。study 是“辅音字母 + y”结尾，变三单要把 y 改成 i 再加 -es：studies；watch 以 ch 结尾，加 -es：watches。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的动词形式是正确的（  ）
options: She go to school by bus.
questions.explanation: He 是第三人称单数，like 加 -s 变成 likes。She go 应改成 goes，They likes 应改成 like（复数不加 -s），I goes 应改成 go。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的动词形式用错了（  ）
options: My mother cook dinner every day.
Lily washes her face at seven.
Tom and Jim play football after school.
questions.explanation: My mother 是第三人称单数，cook 要加 -s 变成 cooks。其余三句：Lily 用 washes，Tom and Jim 是两个人用 play，The cat 用 runs，都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Beibei gets up at six thirty every morning. She has breakfast at seven.” 从句子看，Beibei 几点起床（  ）
questions.explanation: gets up at six thirty 就是六点半起床。七点是她吃早饭的时间，不要把两个时间看反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Mr Li gets up at five. He runs for half an hour, and then he has breakfast.” 从句子看，李先生吃早饭之前先（  ）
questions.explanation: runs for half an hour 在 has breakfast 之前，and then 说明顺序：先跑步，再吃早饭。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom doesn't like ball games. His father runs every morning. Last month Tom began to run with him.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 汤姆现在也早上跑步了
汤姆的爸爸不喜欢运动
questions.explanation: began to run with him 是“开始跟着爸爸跑”，所以现在他也早上跑步。他不喜欢球类运动，更不会每天打球。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My mother ___ dinner every evening.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: every evening 说明是经常做的事，用一般现在时。主语 My mother 是第三人称单数，cook 要加 -s 变成 cooks；cook 是原形，cooking 不能单独作谓语，cooked 是过去式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom ___ his teeth twice a day.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: twice a day 表示习惯，用一般现在时。主语 Tom 是第三人称单数，以 sh 结尾的 brush 要加 -es 变成 brushes；brush 是原形，brushing 不能作谓语，brushed 是过去式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: On Sundays my parents ___ me to the park.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: On Sundays 表示经常发生，用一般现在时。主语 my parents 是复数，动词用原形 take，不加 -s；takes 只配第三人称单数；taking 不能单独作谓语；took 是过去式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister ___. She rides it to school.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 主语 My sister 是第三人称单数，have 要变成 has。have 配 I、you 或复数主语；haves 不是正确形式；having 是现在分词，不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想说“我爸爸每天开车上班”，最恰当的一句是（  ）
options: My father drive to work every day.
My father drives to work every days.
My father drives to work every day.
My father is drive to work every day.
questions.explanation: 主语 My father 是第三人称单数，drive 要加 -s 变成 drives；every day 用单数 day。drive 没加 -s；every days 搭配错误；is drive 把 be 动词和原形混在一起，形式不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把 “She likes apples.” 改成否定句，正确的一项是（  ）
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，否定句用 doesn't，后面的动词回到原形 like。don't 配复数或 I、you；doesn't 后面又加 -s 是重复；not 不能直接放在 likes 前面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个动词的第三人称单数形式写对了（  ）
questions.explanation: go 以 o 结尾，第三人称单数要加 -es，写成 goes。gos 少了一个 e；goies 是乱加字母；going 是现在分词，不是第三人称单数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个句子的主语是第三人称单数（  ）
questions.explanation: My brother 指的是一个人，可以用 he 代替，属于第三人称单数。My parents、The students 都是复数；Tom and Jim 是两个人，也属于复数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 every day 和动词形式不搭配（  ）
options: She go to school every day.
My mother cooks dinner every day.
questions.explanation: every day 表示经常，用一般现在时；主语 She 是第三人称单数，go 应变成 goes，不能用原形。其余选项的主语和动词形式都搭配：单数主语用 plays、cooks，复数主语用 read。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组动词的第三人称单数都加 -es（  ）
questions.explanation: go 变成 goes，watch 变成 watches，都是以 -es 结尾。play 变 plays、read 变 reads，只加 -s；visit、help、like、live 也都是直接加 -s，不加 -es。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 have 的形式用对了（  ）
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，have 的特殊变化是 has。have 只能配 I、you 或复数主语；haves 不是正确形式；having 是现在分词，不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “My sister go to school by bus.” 这句错在哪里（  ）
options: go 应改成过去式 went
by bus 前面要加 the
主语是复数，动词不用变
questions.explanation: My sister 是第三人称单数，一般现在时里 go 要变成 goes，以 o 结尾加 -es。改成 went 会变成过去时，和句子想说的习惯不符；by bus 是固定搭配，不加 the；主语明明是单数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Sam gets up at six every morning and runs for twenty minutes.” 从句子看，Sam 起床后做什么（  ）
questions.explanation: gets up 之后连着 runs for twenty minutes，说明他起床后去跑步。游泳、读书、看电视在句子里都没有出现。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My sister has breakfast at seven and then goes to school.” 从句子看，她吃完早饭后（  ）
questions.explanation: then 后面是 goes to school，说明吃完早饭后去上学。睡觉、看电视、做作业在句子里都没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Lucy usually walks to school, but on rainy days she takes a bus.” 从句子看，下雨天 Lucy（  ）
questions.explanation: but 后面说 on rainy days she takes a bus，takes a bus 就是坐公交上学。走路是平时 usually 的做法；不去上学和骑车，句子里都没有说。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Mr Wang has three English classes in the morning and one in the afternoon.” 从句子看，他一天上几节英语课（  ）
questions.explanation: 上午三节，下午一节，加起来是四节。三节只说出了上午的数量；两节和五节都和句子里的数字对不上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Amy wants to stay healthy, so she doesn't eat ice cream. She has an apple after dinner.” 从句子看，Amy 为什么不吃冰淇淋（  ）
questions.explanation: so 前面说 wants to stay healthy，说明为了健康才不吃冰淇淋。不喜欢甜食、已经吃过晚饭、对冰淇淋过敏，句子里都没有依据。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Ben's father works in a hospital. He rests on Sundays and takes Ben to the park.” 从句子看，星期天 Ben 的爸爸（  ）
options: 在医院上班，很晚才回家
questions.explanation: rests on Sundays 说明星期天休息，takes Ben to the park 说明他带 Ben 去公园。在医院上班是平时的事；一个人去公园、在家睡觉都和句子相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ eat ice cream. I don't like it at all.（选择恰当的频度副词）
questions.explanation: don't like it at all 是“一点也不喜欢”，所以从来不吃：never。其余三个都表示吃，跟后半句矛盾。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My grandpa ___ for a walk after supper.（用 often 填空，选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: often 这类频度副词放在实义动词前面：often goes。主语 my grandpa 是第三人称单数，go 要变成 goes。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把四个频度副词按“总是—经常—有时—从不”的顺序排列（  ）
questions.explanation: 频度从高到低是 always（总是）、often（经常）、sometimes（有时）、never（从不）。sometimes 的频率低于 often，别放反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中频度副词的位置正确（  ）
options: I am always happy at school.
I always am happy at school.
Always I am happy at school.
I am happy always at school.
questions.explanation: 句子里有 be 动词时，频度副词放在 be 后面：I am always happy。放在 am 前面、句首或句末都不合英语习惯。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的意思与其他三句不同（  ）
questions.explanation: sometimes 是“有时”，放在句首、动词前或句末，意思都一样。never 是“从不”，意思正好相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My sister often helps my mother cook, but today she is busy with her homework.” 下面理解正确的是（  ）
options: 她从来不做饭，也不帮妈妈做家务
她每天都帮妈妈做饭，从来不休息
她不喜欢做饭，所以从来不进厨房
她不是每天都帮妈妈做饭
questions.explanation: often 是“经常”，不是“每天”；today 她有事，今天就没帮。把 often 当成 every day，是读这类句子最常见的错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “从不”对应的频度副词是（  ）
questions.explanation: never 的意思是“从不”，表示一次也没有。always 是“总是”，often 是“经常”，usually 是“通常”，都不是“从不”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom ___ reads English in the morning. He does it every day.（选择恰当的频度副词）
questions.explanation: He does it every day 说明每天都这样做，用 always（总是）。never 是从不，often 是经常，usually 是通常，都没有“每天”的意思。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: She ___ at school.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 频度副词要放在 be 动词后面、其他形容词前面，所以是 is always happy。放在 is 前面或句末都不对，少了 is 句子也没有谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: She ___ late. She is always on time.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 频度副词放在 be 动词后面，never 本身已是否定，不能再加 not，所以是 is never late。never is 语序不对，另外两项把否定重复了一次。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: On school days I ___ get up at six, but ___ I get up at seven on Sunday.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 平时六点起床是通常的情况，用 usually；周日七点起床是偶尔，用 sometimes。两个词对调，或者换成 never、always，都与后半句矛盾。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Jack ___ eats sweets. He says they are bad for his teeth.（选择恰当的频度副词）
questions.explanation: 后半句说糖对牙齿不好，说明他从不吃糖，用 never。always、often、usually 都表示经常吃，与后半句的意思矛盾。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个频度副词表示的频率最高？
questions.explanation: always 表示“总是”，频率最高。usually 是“通常”，often 是“经常”，never 是“从不”，频率最低。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句与“I always get up early.”意思相同？
options: I get up early every day.
questions.explanation: always 是“总是”，也就是每天都这样，所以“我每天早起”意思相同。sometimes 是“有时”，never 是“从不”，只说今天早起也没有“每天”的意思。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Does he often play chess? — Yes, he ___.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 简略回答里频度副词要放在助动词前面，说成 he often does。语序颠倒，或者换成 is，都不符合问句里的 does。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My sister never eats meat, so she often eats vegetables.” 下面理解正确的是（  ）
questions.explanation: never 是“从不”，often 是“经常”，合起来就是她不吃肉、常吃蔬菜。其余说法把这两个词的意思弄反了，或者添加了引文里没有的内容。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Lily says she never eats fast food, but I saw her eating hamburgers yesterday.” 可以知道什么？
questions.explanation: 她嘴上说从不吃快餐，却被看到在吃汉堡，说明说的和做的不一样。引文没有说她昨天什么都没吃，也没有说她每天吃汉堡，更不能推出她从不碰食物。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“He is always the first to arrive, and he never leaves before others.” 这句话说明他（  ）
options: 偶尔第一个到，偶尔早走
总是最早到，也从不早走
questions.explanation: always 是“总是”，never 是“从不”，两个词说明他每天最早到，而且从不提前离开。其余说法把这两个词的意思改掉了。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I enjoy ___ mooncakes with my family.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接动名词，不接 to do：enjoy eating。eat、to eat、eats 都不能直接用在这里。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister likes ___ and she enjoys ___.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: like 和 enjoy 后面都可以接动名词：likes singing、enjoys dancing。两个空要一致，不能一个用 -ing、一个用原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lily enjoys ___ storybooks, and she likes ___ pictures of the people in them.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: enjoy 和 like 后面都接动名词，两个空都要用 -ing：reading、drawing。前后两个动词用法一致，不要只改一个。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 的用法正确（  ）
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面只能接动名词：enjoy reading。接 to do、动词原形或三单形式都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句有错误（  ）
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面不能接 to do，应改成 They enjoy playing games。其余三句的 -ing 形式都用对了。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My cousin enjoys ___ noodles. He often ___ noodles for us.” 两个空依次应填（  ）
questions.explanation: 第一个空在 enjoys 后面，用动名词 cooking；第二个空是谓语，主语 He 是第三人称单数，用 cooks。同一个 cook，两种形式各管一处。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: At the Spring Festival, we enjoy ___ together.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接动名词，用 making；to making 把 to 和 ing 混在一起，make 是原形，makes 是第三人称单数，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把 “I like to eat mooncakes.” 改成用 enjoy 说，意思不变，哪一句正确（  ）
questions.explanation: like to eat 和 enjoy eating 意思相同；enjoy 后面要接动名词 eating，to eat、eat、eats 都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Do you enjoy watching the moon? — No, ___（选择正确答句）
questions.explanation: Do you enjoy ...? 的否定回答用 No, I don't.；I'm not 对应 Are you ...?，I can't 对应 Can you ...?，I didn't 对应 Did you ...?。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 春节时，孩子们喜欢一起做灯笼。下面哪一句最自然（  ）
options: Children enjoy to make lanterns together.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接动名词 making；to make 是不定式，make 是原形，makes 是第三人称单数，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 后面直接接了名词（  ）
options: We enjoy watching the moon at night.
We enjoy the moon at the festival.
questions.explanation: the moon 是名词，直接作 enjoy 的宾语；另外三句 enjoy 后面都是动名词短语 watching、eating、making。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What do you enjoy doing at the festival? — ___（选择正确答句）
options: I enjoy to get together with my family.
I enjoy getting together with family.
I enjoy get together with my family.
I enjoy gets together with my family.
questions.explanation: 问句问 enjoy doing，回答也用 enjoy doing：getting together 是动名词；to get 是不定式，get 是原形，gets 是第三人称单数，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的意思与其他三句相反（  ）
options: I love eating mooncakes very much.
I like eating mooncakes very much.
I enjoy eating mooncakes very much.
questions.explanation: don't like 是不喜欢；love、like、enjoy 都表示喜欢，所以这一句意思相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 like 后面的形式不对（  ）
questions.explanation: like 后面接动名词，likes drawing、likes making、likes singing 都对；likes draw 少了 ing，这一句不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 和 like 都用对了（  ）
options: I enjoy to read stories and I like drawing pictures.
I enjoy reading stories and I like to drawing pictures.
I enjoy reading stories and I like drawing pictures.
I enjoy read stories and I like draw pictures.
questions.explanation: enjoy 和 like 后面都接动名词，reading 和 drawing 都对；to read 是不定式，to drawing 混了结构，read 和 draw 是原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 后面的词需要改成 ing 形式（  ）
options: We enjoy play games at the festival.
We enjoy playing games at the festival.
We enjoy making lanterns at the festival.
We enjoy eating mooncakes at the festival.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面要接动名词，play 要改成 playing；其余三句已经用了 playing、making、eating，形式都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 后面接名词和接动名词都用对了（  ）
options: We enjoy the lanterns and we enjoy to make dumplings.
We enjoy the lanterns and we enjoy making dumplings.
We enjoy to see the lanterns and we enjoy making dumplings.
We enjoy see the lanterns and we enjoy make dumplings.
questions.explanation: the lanterns 是名词，可以直接作 enjoy 的宾语；making 是动名词。to make 是不定式，see 和 make 是原形，都不能直接跟在 enjoy 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My sister enjoys to sing and she loves dancing.” 下面哪一种改法把句子改对了（  ）
options: My sister enjoys to singing and she loves dancing.
My sister enjoy singing and she loves dancing.
My sister enjoys sing and she loves dancing.
My sister enjoys singing and she loves dancing.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接动名词，to sing 要改成 singing；to singing 混了结构，enjoy 少了 s 与主语不一致，enjoys sing 少了 ing。后半句 loves dancing 是对的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We usually ___ mooncakes at the Mid-Autumn Festival. Last year we ___ them at home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: usually 表示习惯，用一般现在时 eat；last year 是过去的时间，用过去式 ate。eat 的过去式是不规则的 ate。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My family ___ a big dinner every Spring Festival, but last Spring Festival we ___ it at my grandma's home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: every Spring Festival 说习俗，用一般现在时；my family 在这里指一家人，看作复数用 have。last Spring Festival 说去年，用过去式 had。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Beibei ___ her grandparents every festival. Last year she ___ there by train, but this year she ___ a plane.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: every festival 是习惯，用 visits；last year 用过去式 went；this year 说的是今年已经发生的事，也用过去式 took。三个时间词定三种形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的时态用对了（  ）
options: Last year we eating mooncakes at home.
Last year we ate mooncakes at home.
Last year we eat mooncakes at home.
Last year we eats mooncakes at home.
questions.explanation: last year 是过去的时间，动词要用过去式 ate。eat 是原形，eats 是三单，eating 不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的时间词与动词形式不搭配（  ）
options: Last week we visited my uncle.
Every year we watch the moon.
Last night we watched the moon.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是过去的时间，watch 要改成 watched。其余三句：every year 配 watch，last night 配 watched，last week 配 visited，都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中两个动词的时态都用对了（  ）
options: Every year we ate mooncakes and watched the moon in the garden.
Every Mid-Autumn Festival we eat mooncakes, and last year we ate them in the garden.
Every year we ate mooncakes with my family, and last year we eat them in the garden.
Last year we eat mooncakes and watch the moon in the garden with my family.
questions.explanation: 前一句说习俗用 eat，后一句说去年用 ate；一句话里两种时间各配各的时态才对。其余三句都把两种时间配错了。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The Mid-Autumn Festival is in autumn. On that day families get together and eat mooncakes.” 中秋节这天，一家人会（  ）
questions.explanation: get together and eat mooncakes 就是“聚在一起吃月饼”，这是中秋节的习俗。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We went to my grandma's home. We ate mooncakes in the garden and looked at the moon.” 去年他们是在哪里吃月饼（  ）
questions.explanation: 去了奶奶家，吃月饼的地点是 in the garden，也就是院子里。公园是另一篇短文里的地点，不要混。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last year we went to the park. This year my grandma is ill, so we will stay at home again.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
questions.explanation: will stay at home again 说明今年又在家过，不去公园。去年是去了公园的，所以“每年都去”不成立；奶奶是今年生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Every Lantern Festival, my cousin ___ with us.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: every Lantern Festival 表示每年都这样，用一般现在时；主语 my cousin 是第三人称单数，动词加 es，用 watches the dragon dance。watch 是原形，watched 是过去式，watching 不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We usually ___ fireworks at the Spring Festival, but last year we ___ them in the park.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: usually 指习惯，用一般现在时 set off，them 指 fireworks；but 后面 last year 是过去，用过去式 watched。watch 是现在时，watching 不能单独作谓语，sets off 和主语 we 不搭配。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My uncle visits us every Spring Festival, but last year he ___ to our home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: every Spring Festival 说的是习惯，用 visits；but 后面 last year 是过去，否定要用 didn't come。doesn't come 是现在时，doesn't came 混了两种形式，not come 少了助动词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: —Did your family go to see the lanterns last night? —___（选择正确答语）
questions.explanation: 问句用 Did 开头问过去的事，答句也要用 did；do 是现在时，were 和 are 与 go 不搭配。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Last year my family ___ dumplings every day during the Spring Festival.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 句首 last year 把整件事放在过去，every day 只是那段时间里的频率，所以用过去式 made；make 和 makes 是现在时，making 不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My family eats tangyuan at the Lantern Festival.” 要改成去年发生的事，正确的是（  ）
options: My family eat tangyuan at the Lantern Festival last year.
My family eats tangyuan at the Lantern Festival last year.
My family eating tangyuan at the Lantern Festival last year.
My family ate tangyuan at the Lantern Festival last year.
questions.explanation: 改成去年，要在句子里加 last year，并把 eats 变成过去式 ate；eat 是原形，eats 还是现在时，eating 不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句说的是过去发生的事（  ）
options: We watched the moon last night.
We watch the moon every night.
We watch the moon after dinner.
We often watch the moon together.
questions.explanation: last night 是过去时间，watched 是过去式，说的是过去；every night、after dinner、often 都表示习惯，用现在时 watch。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句说的是经常发生的事（  ）
options: My family got together last Spring Festival.
My family gets together every Spring Festival.
My family got together last night with friends.
My family got together yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: every Spring Festival 表示每年都这样，是习惯，用一般现在时 gets；其余三句都有 last 或 yesterday，是过去的事，用 got。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 last year 和动词形式不搭配（  ）
options: We watched the moon last year.
We visited our grandma last year.
questions.explanation: last year 是过去时间，动词要用过去式 ate；eat 是原形，和 last year 不搭配。其余三句都用了过去式 ate、watched、visited。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同一件事的现在时句与过去时句，哪一组配对正确（  ）
options: Every year we watched the lanterns. Last year we watch them.
Every year we watches the lanterns. Last year we watched them.
Every year we watch the lanterns. Last year we watched them.
Every year we watch the lanterns. Last year we watch them.
questions.explanation: 说每年都看灯，用一般现在时 watch；说去年看灯，用一般过去时 watched。把两个时态交换、用 watches 配 we、或两句都用 watch，都不正确。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My aunt lives in Beijing. Last Spring Festival she comes to our home by train.” 这句话的问题是（  ）
options: 前半句的动词应改成过去式
两个动词都应改成过去式
后半句的动词应改成过去式
两个动词的形式都已正确
questions.explanation: 前半句 lives 说的是现在的常住地，用现在时正确；后半句 last Spring Festival 是过去，comes 要改成 came，所以问题在后半句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We usually visit my grandma at the Spring Festival, but last year we stay at home.” 这句话应该怎么改（  ）
options: 只把前半句的动词改成过去式
只把后半句的动词改成过去式
两个动词都要改成过去式才对
两个动词都不用改，原句正确
questions.explanation: 前半句 usually visit 是习惯，用现在时正确；后半句 last year 是过去，stay 要改成 stayed，所以只需改后半句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“At the Spring Festival, my family gets together and eats dumplings. We also watch TV.” 春节时这家人会做什么（  ）
questions.explanation: 引文说一家人 get together、eat dumplings，还 watch TV。做月饼和赏月是中秋节，赛龙舟和吃粽子是端午节，放风筝和爬山引文没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last Mid-Autumn Festival, we visited my uncle and ate mooncakes on his balcony.” 去年中秋节他们做了什么（  ）
options: 去商店买月饼，还买了灯笼
看望叔叔，在阳台吃月饼
questions.explanation: 引文说 visited my uncle、ate mooncakes on his balcony；公园野餐、在家包饺子、买灯笼都没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Every Spring Festival, our family goes to Grandma's home. Last year we went there by car.” 下面哪一项说法正确（  ）
questions.explanation: 引文说每年春节都去奶奶家，去年是坐汽车去的；不能推出每年都坐汽车，也没有说去年没去或今年坐火车。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Mother usually makes dumplings. Last year Grandma made them because Mother was ill.” 去年是谁包饺子，为什么（  ）
options: 奶奶包的，因为妈妈病了
妈妈包的，因为奶奶病了
奶奶包的，因为她喜欢包
questions.explanation: 引文说 because Mother was ill，所以去年是奶奶包；妈妈病了，不是奶奶病了，也不是奶奶喜欢包或妈妈不忙。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Dad usually drives us to Grandma's. Last year the car was broken, so we went by train.” 这说明什么（  ）
questions.explanation: 引文说 the car was broken，所以去年改坐火车，说明不能开车去；买新车、爸爸不会开车、奶奶家没有汽车都没有根据。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My brother usually watches the moon at home. Last year he was in Beijing and saw it on TV.” 去年弟弟为什么在电视上看月亮（  ）
questions.explanation: 引文说他去年在北京，所以只能在电视上看月亮；生病、家里没有电视、不喜欢月亮都没有根据。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It ___ sunny and cool tomorrow.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: tomorrow 是将来时间，用 will + 动词原形；说天气要用 be 动词，所以是 will be。will 后面不能直接跟形容词，is 和 was 说的是现在和过去。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There ___ a football match in our school next Friday.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: “将有”用 There will be，不能写 There will have——have 前面已经有 there 了。next Friday 说明是将来。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It ___ rainy tomorrow, so we ___ the sports meeting next Saturday.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空都是将来的事：天气用 will be，举办运动会用 will hold（hold 是实义动词，前面用 will）。时间词 tomorrow 和 next Saturday 都定住了将来。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句写的是将来的事（  ）
options: We will visit the farm next week.
We visited the farm last week with our teacher.
We visit the farm every week with our classmates.
We are visiting the farm now with our teacher.
questions.explanation: next week 是将来时间，动词用 will visit。last week 配过去式，every week 配一般现在时，now 配现在进行时。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 will 后面用错了（  ）
options: He will goes to Beijing tomorrow.
She will come back next Monday with her sister.
They will have a picnic in the park this Sunday.
I will help you with your English homework.
questions.explanation: will 后面一律用动词原形，will goes 应改成 will go。will 不随主语变，也没有第三人称单数的形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的时间词与 will 不搭配（  ）
options: I will go to the zoo yesterday.
I will go to the zoo tomorrow.
I will go to the zoo next Sunday.
I will go to the zoo this evening.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是过去的时间，不能和 will 连用，应改成 went。tomorrow、next Sunday、this evening 都是将来时间。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It will be sunny and cool tomorrow. We will go to the park.” 明天的天气怎么样（  ）
questions.explanation: sunny and cool 就是“晴天，凉爽”。两个词要一起看，只看到 sunny 会漏掉 cool。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“There will be a party in our classroom on Friday. We will sing and dance.” 星期五教室里会有什么（  ）
questions.explanation: There will be a party 就是“会有一场聚会”，后面 sing and dance 说的正是聚会上的活动。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It will be rainy tomorrow, so we won't have the picnic. We will stay at home and watch a film.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 他们不喜欢看电影，所以在家睡觉
野餐改不成了，他们在家看电影
明天天气很好，他们按计划去野餐
明天是晴天，他们要去公园野餐
questions.explanation: won't have the picnic 是“不野餐了”，原因是下雨；后面说在家看电影，说明计划改了。so 前后是原因和结果。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We ___ a picnic in the park next Sunday.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: next Sunday 指将来，用 will + 动词原形，所以是 will have。wills 不是词；will has 把原形写成了第三人称单数；will to have 多了 to，will 后面直接跟原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There ___ two new shops near my home next month.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: There will be 表示“将有”，后面接名词，所以是 will be。There will have 是常错写法，there be 句型里不能用 have；will is 把 be 写成了 is；wills 不是词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Look at the black clouds. It ___ rainy this afternoon.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: this afternoon 指还没到的下午，描述天气用 will be + 形容词 rainy。will is 和 is will 都把 be 与 is 混在一起；will was 把过去式放在 will 后面，will 后要用原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom ___ to school tomorrow because he is ill.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: tomorrow 指将来，否定用 won't（也就是 will not）加动词原形，所以是 won't come。will not comes 多加了 -s；doesn't come 是现在的否定，和 tomorrow 不搭；not will come 语序错了。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There ___ a book show next week, and we ___ some new books there.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: “将有”用 There will be，第一空填 will be；and 后面主语是 we，will 后接原形 buy。There will have 不是正确句型；will buys 和 will buying 都没有用动词原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Don't worry. The rain ___ soon, and it ___ sunny again.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: soon 指马上就要发生，用 will 加原形，第一空是 will stop；第二空描述天气，用 will be 加形容词。will stops 没有用原形；will is 把 be 写成了 is；stops 是现在时，和 soon 的将来意思不合。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的 will 后面接的是动词原形（  ）
options: We will visit the museum tomorrow.
We will visits the museum tomorrow.
We will to visit the museum tomorrow.
We will visiting the museum tomorrow.
questions.explanation: will 后面跟动词原形，visit 就是原形。visits 多了 -s；to visit 多了 to；visiting 是 -ing 形式，三者都不符合 will 加原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句表示“将有一个新图书馆”（  ）
options: There will have a new library in our town.
There will be a new library in our town.
There is will a new library in our town.
There will a new library in our town.
questions.explanation: “将有”用 There will be 加名词，所以 There will be a new library 是对的。There will have 混进了 have；There is will 把 is 和 will 叠在一起；There will a new library 少了 be。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的否定形式写对了（  ）
options: She willn't go to the zoo this Saturday.
She won't go to the zoo this Saturday.
She don't will go to the zoo this Saturday.
She not will go to the zoo this Saturday.
questions.explanation: will 的否定是 will not，缩写成 won't，后面接原形 go。willn't 不是正确缩写；don't will 把两个助动词叠在一起；not will 的语序不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的一般疑问句写对了（  ）
options: Do you will come to my party tomorrow?
Will you coming to my party tomorrow?
Will you come to my party tomorrow?
Are you will come to my party tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 把 will 提到句首就构成疑问句，后面接原形 come，所以 Will you come 是对的。Do you will 多了 do；Will you coming 没有用原形；Are you will 把 be 和 will 混在一起。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中两个 will 都用对了（  ）
options: We will go to the park, and we will took some photos.
We will went to the park, and we will take some photos.
We will go to the park, and we will take some photos.
We will going to the park, and we will take some photos.
questions.explanation: will 后面一律接动词原形，所以 will go 和 will take 都对。took 和 went 是过去式，going 是 -ing 形式，都不能跟在 will 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句用 will be 描述天气是正确的（  ）
options: It will be rain and cool in Changsha tomorrow.
It will be rainy and cool tomorrow.
It will rainy and cool in Changsha tomorrow.
It will rains and cool in Changsha tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 描述天气用 will be 加形容词 rainy，所以 It will be rainy and cool 是对的。will be rain 把形容词换成了名词；will rainy 少了 be；will rains 既少了 be，又用了第三人称单数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“There will be a new park near our school next year.” 明年学校附近会有什么（  ）
questions.explanation: There will be a new park 是“将有一个新公园”，near our school 是学校附近。图书馆、操场、医院都换掉了 park 这个词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It will be snowy and cold in Harbin tomorrow.” 明天哈尔滨会下雨吗（  ）
questions.explanation: snowy 是下雪，cold 是冷，句子里没有 rain 这个词。所以明天会下雪、不会下雨；说有雨或者说是晴天，都不符合句子。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We will have a sports meeting next Friday. Every student will run and jump.” 运动会什么时候开（  ）
questions.explanation: next Friday 是下周五，sports meeting 是运动会。下周一、这周五和明天都和 next Friday 对不上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Mum will buy a birthday cake. Dad will cook noodles, and I will make a card.” 妈妈将做什么（  ）
questions.explanation: Mum will buy a birthday cake 是妈妈要买一个生日蛋糕。煮面条的是 Dad，做贺卡的是 I；买贺卡这件事句子里没有说。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It will be windy tomorrow. We will fly kites, but we won't go swimming.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 明天有风，他们要去放风筝
明天有风，他们要去游泳
明天很热，他们要去放风筝
明天有雨，他们不去游泳
questions.explanation: windy 是有风，fly kites 是放风筝；but 后面说 won't go swimming，就是不去游泳。句子没有说热，也没有说下雨。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“There will be a party at six. Please come at five thirty and bring some fruit.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 聚会五点半开始，要带水果
聚会六点开始，要带饮料
聚会六点开始，要带水果
聚会五点半开始，不用带东西
questions.explanation: at six 是六点开始，bring some fruit 是带些水果，所以聚会在六点、要带水果。五点半是到场时间，不是开始时间；饮料和“不用带东西”都和句子相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is ___ today. Take your umbrella with you.（选择恰当的天气词）
questions.explanation: 要带伞说明在下雨，用 rainy。sunny 和 windy 都不需要伞，cloudy 只是多云。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is very ___ today. Let's fly a kite in the park.（选择恰当的天气词）
questions.explanation: 放风筝要有风，所以是 windy。rainy 和 snowy 都不适合出门放风筝。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is ___ today, so we can't go out. We ___ at home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: It is 后面要用形容词 rainy，不能用名词 rain 或动词 rains；will 后面要用动词原形 stay，不能加 -ing。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的天气词用对了（  ）
questions.explanation: It is 后面接形容词：sunny、rainy、windy。sun、rain、wind 是名词，不能直接放在 It is 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中天气与活动配得不合理（  ）
options: It is windy today. Let's fly a kite in the park with my sister.
It is snowy today. Let's go swimming in the river.
It is rainy today. Let's stay at home and read some books.
It is sunny today. Let's go to the park with our teacher.
questions.explanation: 下雪天到河里游泳既不安全也不合常理。其余三句：下雨在家看书、晴天去公园、有风放风筝，都对得上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组句子里的天气词全部用对了（  ）
options: It is sun. / It is rain. / It is wind.
It is sunny. / It is rain. / It is windy.
It is sun. / It is rainy. / It is wind.
It is sunny. / It is rainy. / It is windy.
questions.explanation: 三句都要用形容词形式：sunny、rainy、windy。只要有一处写成名词 sun、rain、wind，整组就不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The ground is white. It is ___ today.（选出最合适的天气词）
questions.explanation: 地上白了说明下过雪，snowy 是下雪的。sunny 是晴朗，windy 是刮风，cloudy 是多云，都解释不了满地白色。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is ___ today. The trees are moving and my hat flies away.（选出最合适的天气词）
questions.explanation: 树在摇、帽子被吹走，说明风很大，windy 是刮风的。sunny、snowy、rainy 都不会把帽子吹走。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is ___ today. We can make a snowman in the garden.（选出最合适的天气词）
questions.explanation: make a snowman 是堆雪人，要有雪，所以用 snowy。rainy 是下雨，windy 是刮风，sunny 是晴朗，都没有雪可以堆雪人。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is ___ today. The water in the bottle turns to ice.（选出最合适的天气词）
questions.explanation: 水结成冰说明天气很冷，用 cold。cloudy 是多云，rainy 是下雨，warm 是暖和，都不会让瓶里的水结冰。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “今天下雨，我们将在家里看书。”下面哪一句英语最合适（  ）
options: It is rainy today. We will read books at school.
It is sunny today. We will read books at home.
It is rainy today. We will read books at home.
It is rainy today. We read books at home tomorrow.
questions.explanation: “下雨”是 rainy，“在家里看书”是 read books at home，用 will 表示将要做。说到学校、说成晴天，或者把 tomorrow 硬塞进句子里的写法，都和原句意思或语法不合。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is snowy today. The children are very happy because they can ___ outside.（选出最合适的活动）
questions.explanation: snowy 是下雪，下雪天可以在外面堆雪人。fly a kite 要有风，go swimming 是游泳，wear sunglasses 是戴太阳镜，都不是下雪天在外面高兴地玩的事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句写的是晴天（  ）
questions.explanation: sunny 是晴朗的，It is sunny today. 就是“今天是晴天”。rainy 是下雨，snowy 是下雪，cloudy 是多云。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的天气词用错了（  ）
options: It is sunny today. The sun is shining.
It is rainy today. The rain is heavy.
It is snowy today. The sun is very hot.
It is windy today. The wind is very strong.
questions.explanation: 下雪天不可能太阳很热，snowy 和 hot sun 自相矛盾。其余三句里，sunny 配太阳出来、rainy 配大雨、windy 配大风，都对得上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句最适合在雨天说（  ）
options: Let's go out and make a snowman.
Let's fly a kite in the park.
Put on your sunglasses and hat.
questions.explanation: 雨天要带伞，Take an umbrella with you. 正合适。堆雪人要有雪，放风筝要有风，戴太阳镜要有太阳，都不适合雨天。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组“天气＋活动”搭配正确（  ）
questions.explanation: 下雪天可以堆雪人，这一组对得上。雨天放风筝、晴天穿雨衣、刮风天游泳，天气和活动都配不上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的天气词和活动都合理（  ）
options: It is sunny. We will wear raincoats.
It is rainy. We stay at home.
It is snowy. We will go swimming.
It is hot. We will make a snowman.
questions.explanation: 下雨天待在家里最合理。晴天穿雨衣、下雪天去游泳、大热天堆雪人，天气和活动都对不上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读对话：“It's rainy today.” “Let's fly a kite in the park.” 下面哪一句说得对（  ）
options: 雨天放风筝是很好的选择
今天天气晴朗，适合放风筝
雨天应该带伞，不该放风筝
questions.explanation: 对话说今天下雨，却提议去放风筝，这不合理；下雨天应该带伞。对话里没有说去游泳，也没有说今天是晴天。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I'd like a ___ of bread for breakfast.（选择正确的量词）
questions.explanation: 面包论“片、块”，用 a piece of bread。bottle 和 glass 用于水、牛奶这类液体，pair 用于成双的东西。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There are two ___ of milk on the table.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: two 后面的量词要变复数：glass → glasses（以 s 结尾加 -es）。glasss 是拼错，a glass 是单数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I will bring two ___ of orange juice and three ___ of bread.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空前面都是大于 1 的数，量词都要变复数：two bottles、three pieces。不可数名词本身不变，变的是量词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个量词与后面的词搭配正确（  ）
questions.explanation: 纸论“张、片”，用 a piece of paper。bottle、glass 用于液体，pair 用于成双的东西，都不能配 paper。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中量词写错了（  ）
options: I'd like a glass of milk.
I'd like a cup of tea.
I'd like two bottle of water.
I'd like two bottles of water.
questions.explanation: two 后面的 bottle 要变复数：two bottles of water。其余三句的量词都是单数，配 a 或没有数词，用原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组里的量词都用了复数形式（  ）
options: three bottle of juice / two cups of tea
three bottles of juice / two cups of tea
three bottle of juice / two cup of tea
three bottles of juice / two cup of tea
questions.explanation: 两组都有大于 1 的数词，量词都要加 -s：three bottles、two cups。只要有一组漏了复数，整组就不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I'd like ___ of tea, please.（选择正确的量词）
questions.explanation: 茶用杯子计量，说 a cup of tea；piece 用于一片一片的东西，bowl 装饭或面，bag 装可以装袋的东西。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选出与 bread 搭配正确的短语：（  ）
questions.explanation: 面包论片，用 a piece of bread；bottle、glass、cup 都装液体，不能用来数面包。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想告诉妈妈早餐想吃两片面包，说：（  ）
options: I'd like two pieces of bread.
I'd like two piece of bread.
I'd like two bottles of bread.
questions.explanation: 两片面包是 two pieces of bread，量词 piece 随数字变复数，bread 不加 s；量词漏 s、bread 加 s、拿 bottle 数面包都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — ___ orange juice do you want? — Two bottles, please.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: orange juice 是不可数名词，问多少用 How much；How many 后面接可数名词复数，How long 问时间长短，How old 问年龄。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “我们需要两瓶橙汁。”用英语怎么说？（  ）
options: We need two bottle of orange juice.
We need two bottles of orange juices.
We need two bottles of orange juice.
questions.explanation: 两瓶是 two bottles，量词随数字变复数；orange juice 不可数，不加 s，也不能直接说 two orange juice。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There isn't much milk. Let's buy two ___ of milk and a ___ of tea.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: two 后面的量词 bottle 要加 s，a 后面的 cup 用单数；milk 和 tea 都是不可数名词，词尾不加 s。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个量词不能和 milk 搭配？（  ）
questions.explanation: 牛奶是液体，用 bottle、glass、cup 计量都行；piece 用来数一片一片的东西，不能说 a piece of milk。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个短语的搭配正确？（  ）
questions.explanation: 米饭论碗，a bowl of rice 正确；茶用 cup，牛奶用 glass 或 bottle，面包用 piece。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句写错了（  ）
options: We need two bottles of water.
She buys three bags of apples.
He wants two breads for lunch.
I'd like two cups of tea, please.
questions.explanation: bread 不可数，不能加 s，要说 two pieces of bread；其余三句的量词都随数字用了复数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组里的量词都用对了？（  ）
options: a bottle of juice, a cup of tea
a bottle of bread, a cup of tea
a piece of juice, a glass of water
a cup of bread, a bag of apples
questions.explanation: 果汁装瓶、茶沏在杯里，两个搭配都对；面包不能用 bottle 或 cup 数，果汁也不能说 a piece of。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中量词和名词的搭配都对？（  ）
options: We need two bottles of apple juices.
We need two bottles of apple juice.
We need two bottle of apple juice.
We need two pieces of apple juice.
questions.explanation: 两瓶苹果汁是 two bottles of apple juice，量词加 s、juice 不加 s；juice 加 s 和量词漏 s 都不对，果汁也不能用 piece 数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “I'd like two cup of tea and three breads.”这句话共有几处错？（  ）
questions.explanation: two 后面的 cup 要写成 cups，这是一处；bread 不可数，three breads 要改成 three pieces of bread，这是第二处。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ swim, but I can't skate.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: can 是情态动词，后面接动词原形，也没有第三人称单数形式：I can swim。can to 和 cans 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What can I do for you? — You can ___ me carry the box.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: can 后面用动词原形 help。What can I do for you? 是主动提出帮忙的说法，回答也用 can + 原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lingling ___ cook noodles, but she ___ make cakes.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: but 表示转折，前后要一正一反：会做面条，不会做蛋糕。can 没有第三人称单数形式，cans 是错的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 can 用得正确（  ）
options: She can to play the piano.
questions.explanation: can 后面用动词原形 play，can 本身不加 -s，也不接 to。所以只有 She can play the piano 是对的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 can 后面用错了（  ）
options: We can go there by bus.
questions.explanation: can 后面要跟动词原形，can sings 应改成 can sing。can 不随主语变，主语是 he 也不加 -s。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 can 的意思与其他三句不同（  ）
options: I can swim in the river every day.
She can ride a bike to school.
He can speak English very well.
questions.explanation: Can you help me? 是“请求别人帮忙”，can 表示请求；其余三句的 can 都表示“会、有能力做”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Can you swim? — Yes, I ___.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 用 Can 提问，就用 can 回答；do 对应助动词提问，am 对应 be 动词提问，will 对应将来时提问，都接不上这句问句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister can ___ the piano very well.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: can 是情态动词，后面一律跟动词原形 play；加 s、加 ing、加 to 都不行。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — ___ I use your ruler? — Sure. Here you are.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 向别人借东西、请求许可用 Can I ...?；Do 提问时要接动词原形，Am 和 Are 后面都不能直接跟 I use。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想帮妈妈做事，问她需要什么帮助，说：（  ）
options: What can you do for me?
What I can do for you?
What do I can for you?
What can I do for you?
questions.explanation: 主动提出帮忙说 What can I do for you?；第二句把帮忙的人和被帮的人说反了，第三句语序错，第四句 do 和 can 重复。
tags: What can I do for you

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lingling can't ___ the box. It's too heavy.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: can't 是情态动词 can 的否定形式，后面跟动词原形 carry；加 s、加 ing、加 to 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: He can ___ English, but he can't ___ Chinese.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: can 和 can't 后面都用动词原形，两个空都填 speak、write 的原形；加 s、加 ing、加 to 都错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: can 后面的动词应该用哪种形式？（  ）
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 后面跟动词原形，既不加 s，也不加 ing，更不加 to。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个与 can't 意思相同？（  ）
questions.explanation: can't 是 cannot 的缩写，两者都表示不能；can 表示能，must 表示必须，not can 词序不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的 can 表示请求，而不是能力？（  ）
questions.explanation: Can I ...? 是在请求许可，想知道能不能用别人的东西；其余三句说的都是会做什么事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中的 can't 用得不对？（  ）
questions.explanation: can't 后面要用动词原形，plays 应改成 play；其余三句的 can't 后面都是原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组里的两句 can 都用对了？（  ）
options: I can swim. She can sings.
I can swim. She can sing.
I can to swim. She can sing.
I can swimming. She can sing.
questions.explanation: can 后面跟动词原形，所以 swim 和 sing 都对；加 s、加 to、加 ing 的写法都错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “She can to sing, but she can't dances.”下面哪一种改法把两处错都改对了（  ）
options: She can to sing, but she can't dance.
She can sing, but she can't dances.
She can sings, but she can't dance.
She can sing, but she can't dance.
questions.explanation: can 后面不能加 to，要写 can sing；can't 后面要用原形，要写 can't dance。只改一处的三个选项各留了一处错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We ___ waste water. Water is useful.
questions.explanation: 水很有用，所以不应该浪费，用 shouldn't + 动词原形 waste。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We should ___ the tap after we wash our hands.
questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形，不加 -s、-ing 或 -ed。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early.
questions.explanation: 对方看起来累，是给建议，用 should；shouldn't 意思相反，can't 表能力，aren't 后不接动词原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We ___ use both sides of the paper, and we ___ throw the bottles away.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空一条建议一条禁止：纸要两面用（should），瓶子不能乱扔（shouldn't）。and 连接的是并列的两条建议，方向相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是在给别人提建议（  ）
options: I can swim very well and run very fast.
He is a doctor in a big hospital.
They will go to the park next Sunday.
questions.explanation: should 用来提建议：你应该多喝水。can 说能力，is 说身份，will 说将来，都不是建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 should 后面用错了（  ）
options: We should use a bag when we shop.
We should to plant more trees.
questions.explanation: should 后面直接跟动词原形，不接 to：should plant。should 和 can 一样，后面一律用原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We shouldn't waste water. We should turn off the tap after washing our hands.” 从句子看，洗完手应该（  ）
questions.explanation: turn off the tap 就是关水龙头，这是句子给的具体建议。shouldn't waste water 是总的原则。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Use both sides of the paper. Don't throw old books away. Give them to younger children.” 这段话主要说的是（  ）
options: 怎样在纸上画好看的图画
怎样把教室打扫得干干净净
怎样节约用纸、让旧书再用
怎样到书店买新的故事书
questions.explanation: 三句说的是一件事的三个做法：纸用两面、旧书别扔、送给更小的孩子。合起来就是节约用纸、让书再用一次。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It is not easy to save water. We should start with small things. Turning off the tap is a good start.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 只有大人才需要节约用水，小孩完全不用管
节约用水可以从关水龙头这样的小事做起
关水龙头没有用，水还是会白白流走
节约用水很容易，根本不用特意做什么
questions.explanation: start with small things 和 a good start 都说从小事做起；前半句 not easy 说的是不容易，不是做不到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: To help the earth, we ___ take a bag when we go shopping.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 购物时自带袋子是建议，用 should 加动词原形；shouldn't 意思相反，should 后面不能加 to，也没有 shoulds 这个形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We should ___ the lights when we leave the room.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形，关灯是 turn off；turning off 是 -ing 形式，to turn off 多了 to，turns off 是三单形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学说：“I'm thirsty.” 你给他提建议，说：（  ）
questions.explanation: 口渴时建议喝水，用 should 加动词原形 drink；加 to、用 -ing 都不对，shouldn't 意思相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把“We should waste paper.”改成否定建议：（  ）
questions.explanation: 否定建议用 shouldn't 加动词原形，should 不能和 don't 连用，也不能在 shouldn't 后加 to，not 要放进 should 里合成 shouldn't。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We should ___ water and we shouldn't ___ rubbish into the river.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个情态动词后面都接动词原形，所以是 save water 和 throw rubbish；加 -ing 或 to 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “It is a good idea to ride a bike to school.”意思相近的是（  ）
options: We shouldn't ride a bike to school.
We should to ride a bike to school.
We can rides a bike to school.
We should ride a bike to school.
questions.explanation: a good idea 就是值得做的建议，用 should 加动词原形；shouldn't 意思相反，should 后多 to、can 后加 s 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是在劝别人不要浪费水（  ）
options: We don't waste water every day.
questions.explanation: shouldn't 加动词原形表示“不应该”，是在提建议；其余三句分别说习惯、正在发生和过去的事，都不是建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中的建议说得不对（  ）
options: We should use both sides of the paper.
We should to turn off the tap.
We should take a bag to the shop.
questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形，不能加 to；turn off 前多了 to，所以这一句错，其余三句形式都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 朋友说：“I'm cold.” 你提建议，说：（  ）
options: You should to put on your coat.
You should put on your coat.
You shouldn't put on your coat.
You should putting on your coat.
questions.explanation: 冷的时候建议穿上外套，用 should 加动词原形 put on；加 to、用 -ing 都不对，shouldn't 意思相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是命令，不是建议（  ）
options: You should turn off the tap.
questions.explanation: 祈使句直接叫人做事，语气是命令；带 should 或 shouldn't 的三句都是在提建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的建议是在节约用纸（  ）
options: Turn off the tap after washing.
Take a bag when you go shopping.
Use both sides of the paper.
Ride a bike to school every day.
questions.explanation: 纸的两面都用，能少砍树、少浪费纸。关水龙头是节水，自带袋子是少用塑料袋，骑车是少开车，都不是节约用纸。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 should 用得对，也符合环保（  ）
options: We should throw the old bottles into the river.
We should recycle the old bottles.
We should to recycle the old bottles.
We shouldn't recycle the old bottles.
questions.explanation: 旧瓶子应该回收，用 should 加动词原形 recycle；扔进河里和不回收都不环保，should 后加 to 形式也不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We should take a bag when we go shopping. Plastic bags are bad for the earth.” 从句子看，购物时应该（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子说购物要带袋子，因为塑料袋对地球不好；多要塑料袋、扔掉袋子都不符合，不去购物也不是句子的建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We should ride a bike to school. It is good for the air.” 句子建议我们上学（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子说骑车上学对空气好，所以建议骑车；坐车、坐飞机、让父母送都不是句子里的建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Don't throw the old bottles away. We should recycle them and make new things.” 句子建议我们（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子说不要扔旧瓶子，要回收再利用；扔掉和藏起来都不对，句子也没让人买新瓶子。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Use both sides of the paper and take a bag to the shop. Small actions help the earth.” 这段话主要说的是（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子举了用纸两面、自带袋子两个小例子，说明小事也能帮地球；说纸只能用一面、要多拿袋子都和句子相反，说靠大事也不是句子的意思。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读对话：“Mum, I want to buy a new toy car.” “Your old one still works. We shouldn't buy another.” 从对话看，妈妈建议孩子（  ）
questions.explanation: 妈妈说旧车还能用，不应该再买，所以是建议继续玩旧的；买新的和句子相反，送人和不再玩都没提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We shouldn't throw rubbish on the ground. We should put it in the bin and recycle it.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子说不要在地上扔垃圾，要放进垃圾桶并回收；扔在地上、倒进河里、不回收都和句子相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: big 的比较级是（  ）
questions.explanation: big 是重读闭音节、末尾只有一个辅音字母，要双写 g 再加 -er：bigger。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This bird is ___ than the first one.
questions.explanation: 有 than 表示两者比较，用比较级 bigger。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This book is ___ than that one.
questions.explanation: interesting 是多音节词，比较级在前面加 more，不加 -er，也不能用最高级 most。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: hot 和 easy 的比较级分别是（  ）
questions.explanation: hot 是重读闭音节、末尾只有一个辅音字母，双写 t 再加 -er：hotter；easy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -er：easier。两种规则不一样。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个比较级写对了（  ）
questions.explanation: tall 直接加 -er：taller。tallor 拼错，talller 多了一个 l（只有重读闭音节才双写），more tall 是多余——单音节词不加 more。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中形容词的 -er 形式写错了（  ）
options: This bag is heavyer than that one.
This bag is heavier than that one.
My hair is longer than yours.
This box is bigger than that one.
questions.explanation: heavy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，要变 y 为 i 再加 -er：heavier。heavy 不能直接加 -er。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: nice 的比较级是（  ）
questions.explanation: nice 以 e 结尾，比较级只加 r，变成 nicer；再加一个 e 或加 more 都不对，nicest 是最高级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “这本书更薄。”用 thin 的比较级，应填（  ）
questions.explanation: thin 是重读闭音节，比较级要双写 n 再加 er，变成 thinner；只加一个 n、加 more 都不对，thinnest 是最高级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Her dress is ___ than mine.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: beautiful 是多音节词，比较级用 more，后面接原级；beautifuler 不是正确形式，most 是最高级，more beautifully 是副词形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “这条河比那条河更宽。”用 wide 的比较级，应说（  ）
options: This river is more wide than that one.
This river is widest than that one.
This river is wideer than that one.
This river is wider than that one.
questions.explanation: wide 以 e 结尾，比较级加 r 变成 wider；加 more 是多余，widest 是最高级，wideer 多写了一个 e。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: important 的比较级是（  ）
questions.explanation: important 是多音节词，比较级在前面加 more，后面用原级；importanter 不是正确形式，most 是最高级，more importantly 是副词形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The bag is ___ (heavy) than the box, and the box is ___ (big) than the cup.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: heavy 变 y 为 i 加 er，big 双写 g 加 er，所以是 heavier 和 bigger；biger 少写一个 g，more heavy 和 heavyer 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组比较级都写对了（  ）
questions.explanation: tall 直接加 er，nice 以 e 结尾加 r，所以 taller 和 nicer 都对；niceer 多写 e，more tall 和 more nice 都不该加 more。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个比较级少写了一个字母（  ）
questions.explanation: thin 要双写 n 再加 er，写成 thinner，thiner 少了一个 n；hotter 和 bigger 的双写都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中的比较级形式正确（  ）
options: This apple is more big than that one.
This apple is biger than that one.
This apple is bigger than that one.
This apple is biggest than that one.
questions.explanation: big 是重读闭音节，比较级双写 g 加 er，bigger 正确；more big 多余，biger 少一个 g，biggest 是最高级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 more 用错了（  ）
options: This box is more heavy than that bag.
This book is more interesting than that one.
This park is more beautiful than that park.
This test is more important than that game.
questions.explanation: heavy 是双音节短词，比较级用 heavier，不用 more heavy；interesting、beautiful、important 都是长词，用 more 是对的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的比较级构成规则与其他三句不同（  ）
options: This tree in the garden is taller than that one.
This dress is more beautiful than that one.
This line on the paper is longer than that one.
This road near my home is shorter than that one.
questions.explanation: beautiful 是多音节词，比较级加 more；taller、longer、shorter 都是短词直接加 er，所以不同的一句是 more beautiful 那一句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的比较级错在双写辅音（  ）
options: This box is more big than that bag.
This box is biggest than that bag.
This box is bigger than that bag.
This box is biger than that bag.
questions.explanation: big 要双写 g 再加 er，biger 少了一个 g，正是双写辅音的错误；more big 错在多加了 more，biggest 是最高级，bigger 形式正确。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My brother is ___ than me.（用 tall 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 有 than 表示两个人比高矮，用比较级 taller。tall 是原级，tallest 是最高级（三者以上才用）。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The Yangtze River is ___ than the Yellow River.（用 long 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 两条河相比，用比较级 longer。more longer 是重复——long 已经加了 -er，前面不能再加 more。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This box is ___ and ___ than that one.（用 heavy, big 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 一个 than 同时带两个比较级：heavy 变 y 为 i 加 -er，big 双写 g 加 -er。两处规则不同，不能只改对一个。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的比较级句型是完整的（  ）
options: Tom is more tall than Jim.
questions.explanation: 比较级句型是「甲 is + 比较级 + than + 乙」，三样都不能少：taller、than、Jim。少 than 或漏 is 都不成句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中比较级用错了（  ）
options: This apple is bigger than that one.
My hair is more long than yours.
My hair is longer than yours.
questions.explanation: long 是单音节词，比较级加 -er：longer，不加 more。more 只用于 interesting、beautiful 这类多音节词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中两个比较级都用对了（  ）
options: This box is bigger and heavyer than that one.
This box is more big and heavier than that one.
This box is biggest and heavier than that one.
This box is bigger and heavier than that one.
questions.explanation: big 双写 g 加 -er，heavy 变 y 为 i 加 -er，两个都要对。其余三句各有一处错：heavyer、more big、biggest（最高级）。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The blue bird is bigger than the yellow one. It is also more beautiful.” 蓝色的鸟比黄色的鸟（  ）
questions.explanation: bigger 是更大，more beautiful 是更好看，also 说明两个优点都有。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom is 12 and Jim is 10. Tom is taller, but Jim runs faster.” 从句子看（  ）
options: 汤姆更高，跑步也比吉姆快
汤姆更高，吉姆跑得更快
questions.explanation: but 表示转折：身高上汤姆占优，跑步上吉姆占优。taller 和 faster 分属两个人，不要都算到一个人头上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My old bike is small. The new one is bigger, but it is heavier, so I ride it more slowly.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 新车更大更重，骑起来更慢
新车骑起来比旧车要快得多
questions.explanation: bigger、heavier 说的是新车，so 引出结果：骑得更慢（more slowly）。三个比较级连成一条因果链。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This jacket is ___.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: than 前面要用比较级，heavy 变 heavier，把 y 改成 i 再加 -er；heavy 是原形，heaviest 是最高级，more heavy 是错误说法。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想告诉同学“我的书包比你的重”，说：（  ）
options: My schoolbag is heavy than yours.
My schoolbag is heavier than yours.
My schoolbag is more heavy than yours.
My schoolbag is heaviest than yours.
questions.explanation: 比较书包轻重用比较级 heavier，后面接 than yours；heavy 是原形，more heavy 多加了 more，heaviest 是最高级，都不能跟 than 连用。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “Lucy is younger than Lily.” 与哪一句意思相同？（  ）
options: Lily and Lucy are the same age.
questions.explanation: Lucy 比 Lily 小，反过来就是 Lily 比 Lucy 大，所以 older than 意思相同；另外两句把年龄方向说反了，最后一句说两人同岁，也不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面这句哪里说错了：“My hair is more long than yours.”（  ）
options: 把 more long 改成 longest
把 more long 改成 longer
把 than 改成 to 才对
把 yours 改成 your 才对
questions.explanation: long 是单音节词，比较级直接加 -er，不能用 more long；longest 是最高级，than 后面接比较对象不能换成 to，yours 表示你的头发，本身没错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Which is bigger, your bedroom or your study? — ___（选择正确回答）
options: My bedroom is big than my study.
My bedroom is bigger to my study.
My bedroom is bigger than my study.
My bedroom is more big than my study.
questions.explanation: 问两者哪个更大，回答要用比较级 bigger，并用 than 引出比较对象。big 是原形，to 不能代替 than，more big 也不是正确形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把 “The red kite is big. The blue kite is small.” 合成一句，正确的是（  ）
options: The red kite is big than the blue one.
The blue kite is bigger than the red one.
The red kite is biggest than the blue one.
The red kite is bigger than the blue one.
questions.explanation: 两句合一句要比大小，big 变 bigger，后面用 than the blue one 代替 the blue kite。big 没变比较级，方向说反，biggest 是最高级，都不能和 than 搭配。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 than 前面的形容词形式不对（  ）
options: He is tall than his brother.
He is taller than his brother.
She is older than her sister.
She is younger than her brother.
questions.explanation: than 前面要用比较级，tall 应变成 taller；tall 是原形。其余三句的 taller、older、younger 都是正确的比较级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的 than 用对了（  ）
options: This box is heavier to that one.
This box is heavier than that one.
This box is more heavy than that one.
This box is heaviest than that one.
questions.explanation: 两者比较用 than，不用 to；heavy 的比较级是 heavier，不加 more，也不用最高级 heaviest。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “Tom is more taller than Jim.” 改对后是（  ）
options: Tom is more tall than Jim.
questions.explanation: taller 本身就是比较级，前面不能再加 more；tallest 是最高级，more tall 和 tall 都没有正确构成比较级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 than 后面的比较对象写得对（  ）
options: My bike is newer than your.
My bike is newer than you.
My bike is newer than yours.
My bike is newer than your's.
questions.explanation: 比较的是两辆自行车，than 后面用 yours 代替 your bike；your 后面缺名词，you 指人，your's 不是正确写法。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句既用了 than，又把比较级写对了（  ）
options: She is carefuller than her brother.
She is more careful to her brother.
She is more careful than her brother.
She is the most careful than her brother.
questions.explanation: careful 是多音节词，比较级用 more careful，后面接 than；carefuller 拼法不对，to 不能代替 than，most careful 是最高级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面这句改对后是：“This book is more interesting and more cheaper than that one.”（  ）
options: This book is more interesting and more cheap than that one.
This book is more interesting and cheaper than that one.
This book is interestinger and cheaper than that one.
This book is most interesting and cheapest than that one.
questions.explanation: interesting 用 more 构成比较级，cheap 是单音节词，直接加 -er 变 cheaper，不能再加 more；最后一句还把两个词都写成了最高级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The elephant is heavier than the horse.” 大象比马（  ）
questions.explanation: heavier 是 heavy 的比较级，意思是更重，所以大象比马重。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Amy's ruler is longer than Ben's.” 谁的尺子长？（  ）
questions.explanation: longer than 表示比……长，Amy 的尺子比 Ben 的长，所以 Amy 的更长。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The green bag is heavier than the blue one, but it is cheaper.” 从句子看（  ）
options: 两个包一样重，价格不同
questions.explanation: 前半句说绿包比蓝包重，后半句 but 转折，说绿包更便宜；另外几句把轻重或价格说反，或说成一样重。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My old schoolbag is small but light. The new one is big and heavy.” 从句子看（  ）
questions.explanation: 旧书包 small but light，新书包 big and heavy，所以旧的小而轻。另外几句把大小轻重说反，或说成一样。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The new phone is bigger but more expensive, so I still use my old one.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 旧手机更便宜，我还在用它
新手机更便宜，我天天用它
旧手机更大，我不喜欢它
questions.explanation: 新手机 bigger but more expensive，说明它更大也更贵；so 引出结果，我还是用旧手机，可见旧手机更便宜。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The yellow bird is smaller than the blue one. But the blue one sings more beautifully.” 从句子看（  ）
options: 黄鸟小，唱得也比蓝鸟好
questions.explanation: 前半句说黄鸟比蓝鸟小，后半句 but 转折，说蓝鸟唱得更动听，所以黄鸟小、蓝鸟唱得好。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What's wrong with you?  — I ___ a headache.
questions.explanation: 问病情用 What's wrong with you，回答是一般现在时；主语 I 用 have，不用 has。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句表示「我感冒了」，说法正确？
questions.explanation: have a cold 是固定搭配：cold 前要加 a，且 cold 在这里不可数，不能加 -s；be 动词不能和 cold 搭配表示生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister ___ a bad cold, so she ___ at home today.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 主语 my sister 是第三人称单数，have 要变成 has；后半句主语 she 也是第三人称单数，stay 加 -s。两个空都要变。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom ___ a headache and a fever. He ___ to see a doctor and ___ some medicine.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 第一空主语 Tom 用 has；第二空 needs to 后面接原形；第三空与 see 并列，同属 needs to 后面，也用原形 take。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I have a cold. My head hurts and I can't stop coughing.” 这个孩子怎么了（  ）
questions.explanation: have a cold 是感冒，head hurts 是头疼，coughing 是咳嗽。三个症状对得上“感冒”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Lily has a fever. The doctor says she should stay in bed for two days and drink more water.” 医生让 Lily（  ）
questions.explanation: stay in bed for two days 是卧床两天，drink more water 是多喝水。should 后面的两件事都是医生说的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom has a cough but no fever. He can go to school, but he shouldn't run.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 汤姆什么病也没有，很健康
汤姆可以在操场上跑，还能上体育课
汤姆能上学，但不能在操场上跑
汤姆发烧了，所以不能去上学
questions.explanation: doesn't have a fever 否掉了发烧；can go to school 和 but he shouldn't run 是两条相反的态度：能去，但不能跑。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句表示“我发烧了”（  ）
questions.explanation: have a fever 是固定搭配：fever 前要加 a，也不能加 -s。be 动词不能和 fever 搭配表示生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 have / has 用错了（  ）
questions.explanation: my parents 是两个人，看作复数，要用 have。其余三句的主语分别是单数 my father、I、she，用 has 或 have 都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 看病时，见到医生最先说的一句是（  ）
questions.explanation: 看病先说自己的感受：I don't feel well（我不舒服）。Goodbye 是告别，Thank you 是道谢，Here you are 是递东西。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把看病的三句话排成通顺的顺序：① I have a cold. ② What's wrong with you? ③ You should drink more water.（  ）
questions.explanation: 先问（②），再答（①），最后给建议（③）。问—答—建议，这是一段看病的对话顺序。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组问答搭配得最合适（  ）
options: — What's wrong with you? — It's Monday.
— What's wrong with you? — I like apples very much.
— What's wrong with you? — I have a bad cold.
— What's wrong with you? — I'm twelve.
questions.explanation: What's wrong with you? 问的是身体怎么了，只能答病情：I have a bad cold。年龄、星期、喜好都答非所问。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I have a bad cold. I should go to the hospital and ___.
questions.explanation: 重感冒要去医院看病，see a doctor 是看医生。看电影、看朋友、看熊猫，都治不了感冒。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What's wrong with you?  — I have a ___. I can't stop coughing.
questions.explanation: can't stop coughing 是咳个不停，说的症状就是咳嗽，用 have a cough。感冒、发烧、头疼都不能直接对应“咳个不停”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “What's wrong with you?” 还可以说成（  ）
questions.explanation: What's wrong with you? 是问“你怎么了”，What's the matter? 意思一样。问名字、问这个用英语怎么说、问时间，都不是问病情。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学脸色发白，你想问他哪里不舒服，应该说（  ）
options: What do you want to eat?
questions.explanation: 同学脸色不好，要问他哪里不舒服，用 What's wrong with you?。问想吃什么、从哪来、多大，都问不到病情。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学说 “I have a bad cold.” 下面哪一句是接着追问病情最自然的一句（  ）
options: Do you have a fever, too?
questions.explanation: 对方说得了重感冒，接着问“有没有发烧”最自然。问电影、问是不是学生、问名字，都接不上病情这个话题。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组主语和 have 或 has 搭配正确（  ）
questions.explanation: I 后面用 have，He 和 She 后面要用 has，They 后面用 have。所以 I 配 have a cold 这一组对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Sam has a bad cold. He should stay in bed.” Sam 应该（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子里说 He should stay in bed，就是卧床休息。去上学、踢足球、吃冰淇淋，都不适合重感冒的孩子。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Lucy has a fever. She can't go to school today.” 下面哪一句说错了（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子说她发烧、今天不能上学，可见她生病了。说她今天感觉很好，和句子正好相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I don't feel well today.” 下面哪一句意思相同（  ）
questions.explanation: I don't feel well 是身体不舒服，和 I am not fine today 意思相同。很开心、不忙、很好，都不是不舒服。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Mike has a bad cold. He is in bed now.” 你去看他，最合适说（  ）
questions.explanation: Mike 重感冒躺在床上，看他时劝他吃药最合适。约他踢球、夸他气色好、祝他旅途愉快，都不合适。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读短文：“Tom has a headache. He should take some medicine and stay in bed for two days.” 医生让他（  ）
options: run in the park every day
questions.explanation: 短文说他头疼，应该吃药并卧床两天，所以是吃药休息。去上学、喝冷水、每天跑步，短文里都没有。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读三句话：“I have a fever.” “You should see a doctor.” “OK, thank you.” 三句话的正确顺序是（  ）
questions.explanation: 先说发烧，医生再建议看医生，最后道谢，所以顺序是病情、建议、道谢。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My tooth hurts badly. I ___.（选最合适的说法）
questions.explanation: 牙疼得厉害，就是 have a toothache。重感冒、咳嗽厉害、发烧，都不会让牙齿疼。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句不是说自己身体不舒服（  ）
questions.explanation: 有一辆新自行车和身体不舒服无关。重感冒、发烧、咳嗽，都是在说身体不好。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “He is ill.” 和下面哪一句意思最接近（  ）
