questions.explanation: ill 是生病的、身体不舒服，He feels bad now 意思最接近。感觉很好、个子高、在学校，都不表示生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 早上起床头疼，你想告诉妈妈，最合适说（  ）
options: I have a big lunch, Mum.
I have a new book, Mum.
I have a good idea, Mum.
questions.explanation: 头疼是 have a headache。吃午饭、有新书、有好主意，都没有说到身体不舒服。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读对话：“What's wrong with you?” “I have a cold, but I don't have a fever.” 下面哪一句对（  ）
questions.explanation: 答句说 I have a cold, but I don't have a fever，就是有感冒、没有发烧。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组“症状—做法”配得最合理（  ）
options: have a fever — see a doctor
have a cold — eat ice cream
have a headache — run a race
questions.explanation: 发烧要看医生，这一组最合理。发烧去游泳、感冒吃冰淇淋、头疼去赛跑，都会让身体更难受。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想告诉妈妈“我感冒了”，应该说（  ）
questions.explanation: 感冒是 have a cold，所以要说 I have a cold, Mum.。have a rest 是休息一下，have a cake 是吃蛋糕，have a look 是看一看。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 医生问 “What's wrong with you?”，下面哪一句不能回答（  ）
questions.explanation: 医生问哪里不舒服，要回答感冒、发烧、头疼。说自己有一件新外套，答的不是病情。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “I have a cold.” 下面哪一句意思最接近（  ）
questions.explanation: 感冒就是身体不舒服，I am not feeling well 意思最接近。感觉很好、想要新外套、喜欢冷水，都和感冒无关。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 医生检查完说 “Take this medicine twice a day.” 你回答（  ）
questions.explanation: 医生说一天吃两次药，病人答应并道谢最合适。说自己感冒了、说听到这事很难过、说不用谢，都不像病人的回答。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读对话：“What's wrong with you?” “I have a bad cold.” 医生接着最可能说（  ）
options: You should eat more ice cream.
You should run in the rain.
questions.explanation: 病人说得了重感冒，医生会给建议吃药。让去游泳、吃冰淇淋、在雨里跑，只会让感冒更重。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把看病的对话排成通顺顺序：① I have a fever. ② Take this medicine and stay in bed. ③ What's wrong with you? ④ Thank you, doctor.（  ）
questions.explanation: 先问怎么了，再回答发烧，医生接着给建议吃药休息，最后道谢，所以是先问、再答、再建议、最后道谢。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You have a cold. You ___ drink more water.
questions.explanation: 感冒了多喝水是建议，用 should + 动词原形；shouldn't 意思相反，can't 表能力，aren't 后不能直接接动词原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You shouldn't ___ too much ice cream when you have a fever.
questions.explanation: shouldn't 是情态动词的否定形式，后面一律接动词原形，不加 -s、-ing 或 -ed。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You have a fever. You ___ stay in bed and ___ more water.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 发烧了应该卧床、多喝水：should 后面两个动词都用原形 drink，且 should 只管一个方向，不能用 shouldn't。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom has a bad cold. He ___ go to school today, and he ___ take the medicine three times a day.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 重感冒不该去学校（shouldn't），但要按时吃药（should）。同一段建议里两条方向相反，靠 and 并列。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“You have a cough. You should drink more water and shouldn't eat ice cream.” 咳嗽的时候应该（  ）
questions.explanation: should 后面是应该做的：多喝水；shouldn't 后面是不能做的：吃冰激凌。两个方向要分清。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Lily should take the medicine and stay in bed, but she shouldn't read for long.” 医生给 Lily 的建议是（  ）
options: 只吃药就行，还可以长时间看书
吃药、卧床，但不要长时间看书
questions.explanation: should 后面两件事（吃药、卧床），but 后面是 should not：不要长时间看书。三件事要一起看。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“You should drink more water. If you still feel bad after three days, you should see a doctor.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 感冒三天还没好，就应该去看医生
一感冒就一定要马上去医院
感冒以后都不该多喝水
感冒三天以后一定就会自己好起来
questions.explanation: if ... after three days 说的是“三天后仍不舒服”才去看医生，不是一感冒就去；前面还说要多喝水。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是给病人的建议（  ）
options: She has a high fever today.
questions.explanation: You should ... 是给别人提建议；其余三句只是陈述病情或身份，没有建议的意思。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 should / shouldn't 用得不合适（  ）
options: You have a fever. You should go swimming.
You have a cold. You should drink more water.
You have a cough. You shouldn't eat ice cream.
You have a headache. You should have a rest.
questions.explanation: 发烧了还去游泳，与养病相反，应该用 shouldn't。其余三句的建议都合常理：多喝水、不吃冰激凌、休息。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学感冒了，你对他说（  ）
options: You should eat more ice cream.
You should run in the playground.
questions.explanation: 感冒了多喝水是合适的建议。吃冰激凌、不去看医生、去操场跑，三条都跟养病相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “— I have a bad cold. — ______” 横线上最合适的一句是（  ）
options: It's half past seven in the morning.
You should take the medicine and have a rest.
I have a cold, too, and thank you for asking me.
Yes, I am a middle school student.
questions.explanation: 对方说重感冒，接一句建议最合适：吃药、休息。回答年龄、身份、时间都答非所问。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组建议适合发烧的病人（  ）
options: eat more sweets / go swimming / stay up late
have a rest / drink more water / take the medicine
run in the playground / eat ice cream / watch TV all night
go to school / play football / drink cold water
questions.explanation: 发烧要休息、多喝水、吃药，三件事都指向养病。其余三组都是消耗体力或受凉的做法，与病情相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Amy has a cough. She ___ drink more water.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 咳嗽时应该多喝水，should 后面直接跟动词原形 drink。should to 多了 to；shoulds 不是词；shouldn't 表示“不应该”，和句意相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Ben has a bad cold. He ___ go to school today.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 重感冒不该去上学，shouldn't 后面跟动词原形 go。shouldn't to 多了 to；don't should 把两个助动词叠在一起；not should 语序不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 与 “You shouldn't eat too much ice cream.” 意思相同的是（  ）
options: You should not eat too much ice cream.
You should eat too much ice cream.
You shouldn't to eat too much ice cream.
You don't should eat too much ice cream.
questions.explanation: shouldn't 是 should not 的缩写，遇到 eat too much ice cream 时，两句都表示“不应该吃太多冰淇淋”。去掉 not 的说法意思正好相反；shouldn't to 多了 to；don't should 不能这样连用。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You should ___ the medicine after dinner.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: should 后面用动词原形，所以是 take。takes 是第三人称单数；taking 是 -ing 形式；took 是过去式，都不能直接放在 should 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Kate has a bad cold. She ___ go out, and she ___ stay at home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 重感冒不该出门、应该待在家，第一个空用 shouldn't，第二个空用 should，后面都跟动词原形。第二个空填 shouldn't 或 should not 都变成“不该待在家”；第一个空填 should 则变成“应该出门”；shouldn't to 多了 to。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lily has a cough. She shouldn't ___ , and she should ___ more water.（选择正确形式）
options: to talk too much; to drink
questions.explanation: shouldn't 和 should 后面都跟动词原形，所以是 talk too much 和 drink more water；加 -s、-ing 或 to 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I have a fever. The doctor says I should stay in bed and drink more water.” 医生让“我”做什么（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子说 should stay in bed and drink more water，就是卧床休息、多喝水。吃冰淇淋、上学、看电视跑步都没有出现在建议里，也和发烧时该做的相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“You shouldn't eat too much ice cream,” the doctor says. “You should drink warm water.” 医生认为不应该做什么（  ）
questions.explanation: shouldn't 后面是 eat too much ice cream，医生不建议吃太多冰淇淋。喝温水是 should 的建议；好好休息和按时吃药都是合理的做法，句子并没有反对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“You should take this medicine twice a day, but you shouldn't drink cold water,” the doctor says. 医生的意思是什么（  ）
options: 一天吃三次药，多喝冷水
一天吃两次药，多喝冷水
一天吃两次药，别喝冷水
questions.explanation: twice a day 是一天两次，shouldn't drink cold water 是别喝冷水，合起来就是“一天吃两次药，别喝冷水”。三次药、不用吃药都和 twice a day 不符；把 shouldn't 换成 should 的说法正好说反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Drink more water and take a rest. Don't eat ice cream,” Dad says to Emma. 爸爸认为 Emma 不应该做什么（  ）
questions.explanation: Don't eat ice cream 就是不要吃冰淇淋。多喝水、好好休息是爸爸让 Emma 做的；按时吃药句子没有提到，也不是爸爸反对的事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist. Don't eat too many sweets,” Mum says. 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 牙疼不用看医生，多吃糖就好
牙疼要看牙医，还要少吃糖
牙疼要多吃糖，不用看牙医
只有大人牙疼才要看牙医
questions.explanation: if your tooth hurts 时应该 see a dentist，同时 Don't eat too many sweets，所以是看牙医、少吃糖。其余几条把应该和不应该说反了，或者加了句子里没有的“只有大人”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“You should drink more water. Come back in three days if you still feel sick.” 医生让 Ben 三天后做什么（  ）
questions.explanation: come back in three days if you still feel sick 是说三天后还不舒服就再来，不是一定要打针。别喝水、马上住院都和句子相反，或者句子根本没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的 should 用对了（  ）
options: You should to drink more water.
questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形 drink，所以 You should drink more water. 是对的。drinks 多了 -s；should to drink 多了 to；should drinking 用了 -ing 形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是在劝阻病人（  ）
options: You should eat too much ice cream every day.
You shouldn't to eat ice cream.
You shouldn't eat too much ice cream.
You don't should eat ice cream.
questions.explanation: 劝阻用 shouldn't + 动词原形，You shouldn't eat too much ice cream. 是对的。用 should 的说法是在鼓励吃冰淇淋；shouldn't to 多了 to；don't should 两个词不能这样叠用。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句给咳嗽病人的建议不合适（  ）
options: You should drink more water for your cough.
You should stay in bed and rest.
You should take your medicine three times a day.
You should eat more ice cream for your cough.
questions.explanation: 咳嗽时吃更多冰淇淋会让嗓子更难受，这条建议不合适。多喝水、卧床休息、按时吃药都是照顾咳嗽病人的常见做法。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句不是给病人的建议（  ）
options: I have a bad cold today.
questions.explanation: 说自己得了重感冒只是在讲病情，没有给别人建议。其余三句都用 should 或 shouldn't 告诉病人该做什么、不该做什么。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的写法有错误（  ）
options: He should to see a doctor.
questions.explanation: should 后面直接跟动词原形，不能加 to，所以 should to see 有错误。其余三句分别是肯定、否定和疑问，写法都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的 should / shouldn't 和病情搭配得不对（  ）
options: You have a fever. You should run outside.
You have a fever. You should stay in bed.
You have a cough. You shouldn't eat ice cream.
You have a toothache. You should see a dentist.
questions.explanation: 发烧时应该休息，不该到外面跑步，You have a fever. You should run outside. 搭配不对。发烧卧床、咳嗽不吃冰淇淋、牙疼看牙医都合情合理。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同桌咳嗽得厉害，你建议他（  ）
options: You should eat more ice cream.
questions.explanation: 咳嗽时多喝水是合适的建议，用 You should drink more water. 表达。吃冰淇淋、不喝水都会让咳嗽更难受；游泳也不适合正在咳嗽的人。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 朋友发烧了，你劝他（  ）
options: You should go to school and play football.
You shouldn't go to school today.
You shouldn't stay in bed at home.
questions.explanation: 发烧时不该去上学，用 You shouldn't go to school today. 劝阻。去上学还踢球、不该卧床、去踢球都不利于退烧。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — I have a toothache. — ______（选择应答句）
questions.explanation: 牙疼应该去看牙医，回答用 You should see a dentist。吃更多糖、不看牙医会让牙更疼；喝冷水也不是治牙疼的建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What should I do? I have a bad cold. — ______（选择应答句）
options: You should rest and drink water.
You should go out and play football.
You should eat more ice cream.
questions.explanation: 重感冒应该休息、喝水，所以选 You should rest and drink water。出去玩球、不喝水、吃冰淇淋都会让感冒更重。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 给感冒病人提两条建议，哪一句最合适（  ）
options: You should drink more water and should stay up late.
You shouldn't drink water and should stay up late.
You should drink more water and shouldn't stay up late.
You should eat more ice cream and shouldn't see a doctor.
questions.explanation: 感冒时要多喝水、不熬夜，You should drink more water and shouldn't stay up late. 两个分句都用对了。说 should stay up late 的让人熬夜；说不喝水的既不补水又熬夜；说吃冰淇淋、不看医生的更不合适。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“① I have a cough. ② You should drink more water. ③ Thank you.” 排成一段对话，顺序正确的是（  ）
questions.explanation: 先说病情 I have a cough.，再给建议 You should drink more water.，最后道谢 Thank you.，所以顺序是①—②—③。先给建议再讲病情、先道谢都不合对话常理。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The Spring Festival is the ___ festival in China.（用 big 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 三者以上相比用最高级；big 是重读闭音节，双写 g 再加 -est：biggest。前面已经有 the，后面不能再加 most。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which festival is ___ in China, the Spring Festival or the Mid-Autumn Festival?（用 important 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 两者相比用比较级 more important，不用最高级。句子里用 or 列出两个节日，说明只在两者之间比。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The Spring Festival is ___ festival in China, and it is also ___ than the Mid-Autumn Festival.（用 important 的正确形式填空）
options: the most important; the most important
questions.explanation: 前半句说“全国最重要的”，三者以上用最高级 the most important；后半句有 than，两者比较用比较级 more important。同一句里两种形式各管一处。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句用了最高级（  ）
options: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.
The Spring Festival is more important than the Mid-Autumn Festival.
Families get together at the Spring Festival.
People eat dumplings at the Spring Festival.
questions.explanation: the most important 是最高级，表示“最重要的”。more important than 是比较级，后两句只讲习俗，没有比较。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中最高级用错了（  ）
options: It is the best time to visit my grandma.
This is the most big festival in China.
This is the most popular festival in China.
This is the busiest day of the year.
questions.explanation: big 是单音节词，最高级是 biggest，不能用 most big。popular 是多音节词才加 most，busy 变 y 为 i 加 -est，good 的最高级是不规则的 best。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中三个最高级的形式都用对了（  ）
options: It is the biggest festival. / the busiest day. / the most popular one.
It is the biggest festival. / the busiest day. / the most popularest one.
It is the bigest festival. / the busiest day. / the most popular one.
It is the biggest festival. / the busyest day. / the most popular one.
questions.explanation: 三条规则各管一类词：big 双写 g 加 -est，busy 变 y 为 i 加 -est，popular 多音节前加 most。有一处写错，整组就不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“At the Spring Festival, families get together and eat dumplings. Children get red packets.” 春节时孩子们会得到（  ）
questions.explanation: red packets 就是红包，这是春节的习俗。月饼是中秋节的，圣诞礼物和火鸡是圣诞节的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Christmas is the most popular festival in many Western countries.” 从句子看，圣诞节（  ）
options: 在很多西方国家是最受欢迎的节日
在中国是一年里最重要的传统节日
那天孩子们还要去上学
那天家人不在一起吃晚饭
questions.explanation: the most popular festival in many Western countries 说的是“在很多西方国家最受欢迎”。在中国最重要的节日是春节，两个国家不要混。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Both are important. But for Chinese families, the Spring Festival is the most important.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 中国家庭从来都不过圣诞节
对中国家庭来说春节最重要
questions.explanation: Both are important 说的是两个都重要，but 之后才给结论：对中国家庭来说春节最重要（the most important）。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The Spring Festival is ___ for children.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 春节是孩子们最快乐的时候，happy 的最高级是 happiest，前面加 the；happier 是比较级，happy 是原形，most happy 不是正确形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想说“春节是最好的节日”，说：（  ）
options: The Spring Festival is the goodest festival.
The Spring Festival is the best festival.
The Spring Festival is the better festival.
The Spring Festival is the most good festival.
questions.explanation: good 的最高级是不规则变化 best，前面加 the；goodest 和 most good 都不是正确形式，better 是比较级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Of the three festivals, the Spring Festival is ___.（用 important 的正确形式）
questions.explanation: 三者比较用最高级，important 是多音节词，前面加 the most；more important 用于两者比较，另外两个少了 most 或重复了最高级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面这句哪里错了：“Of all the festivals, I like the Spring Festival bestest.”（  ）
options: like 要改成 likes 才对
questions.explanation: good 的最高级是 best，不能写成 bestest；better 是比较级，主语 I 后面的 like 用原形，festivals 是复数，都没有错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你想说“在所有节日中，春节是最重要的”，说：（  ）
options: Of all the festivals, the Spring Festival is the more important.
Of all the festivals, the Spring Festival is the most importantest.
Of all the festivals, the Spring Festival is the most important.
Of all the festivals, the Spring Festival is the important most.
questions.explanation: 表示在所有节日中排第一，要用最高级 the most important；more important 是比较级，most importantest 重复了最高级，important most 词序不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面这句话哪里要改：“The Spring Festival is most important festival in China.”（  ）
options: 要在 most 前加 the
questions.explanation: 最高级前要加 the，most important 前缺了 the；festival 这里是单数，不用改成复数，most 不能换成 more，in China 表示范围是对的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句不是最高级（  ）
options: The Spring Festival is the most important festival.
Christmas is the most popular festival in the West.
Mid-Autumn is more popular than Dragon Boat.
The Dragon Boat Festival is the oldest of the three.
questions.explanation: 最高级表示“最……”，常和 the 连用；第三句用 more popular than，是两者比较的比较级，不是最高级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中最高级的形式写对了（  ）
options: She is tallest girl in her class.
She is the tallest girl in her class.
She is the taller girl in her class.
She is the most tall girl in her class.
questions.explanation: tall 是单音节词，最高级加 -est，并在前面加 the；缺 the、用比较级 taller、用 most tall 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中最高级后面的范围写得对（  ）
options: She is the youngest in the three.
She is the youngest of the three.
She is the younger of the three.
She is the most young of the three.
questions.explanation: 三个孩子比较用最高级，范围是三个时用 of the three；in the three 说法不对，younger 是比较级，most young 不是正确形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “This is the most biggest cake in the shop.” 改对后是（  ）
options: This is the most big cake in the shop.
This is the bigger cake in the shop.
This is the biggest cake in the shop.
This is the biggest than the shop.
questions.explanation: big 的最高级是 biggest，不能再加 most；most big 缺 -est，bigger 是比较级，biggest 后面也不能接 than。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 good 的最高级用对了（  ）
options: Lucy is the goodest singer in our class.
Lucy is the bestest singer in our class.
Lucy is the best singer in our class.
Lucy is the better singer in our class.
questions.explanation: good 的最高级是不规则变化 best；goodest 和 bestest 都是错误拼写，better 是比较级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中最高级的用法和形式都正确（  ）
options: Of all the festivals, Christmas is most popular one.
Of all the festivals, Christmas is the most popular.
Of all the festivals, Christmas is the more popular.
Of all the festivals, Christmas is the most popularer.
questions.explanation: of all 表示在全部节日中，用最高级 the most popular；少了 the、用比较级 more popular、把 popular 再加 -er 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“At the Mid-Autumn Festival, families eat mooncakes and look at the moon.” 中秋节人们会（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子里说 eat mooncakes and look at the moon，就是吃月饼、赏月；粽子龙舟是端午，饺子红包是春节，圣诞树是圣诞。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Children get red packets at the Spring Festival.” 孩子们在春节会得到（  ）
questions.explanation: red packets 是红包，春节时长辈给孩子红包；月饼是中秋节，粽子是端午节，圣诞礼物是圣诞节。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Of the three festivals, the Dragon Boat Festival is the oldest.” 这三个节日里最古老的是（  ）
questions.explanation: 句子说 the Dragon Boat Festival is the oldest，三个里最古老的是端午。说成春节、中秋，或说三个一样古老，都和句子不符。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Of the three big festivals, the Spring Festival is the most important.” 从句子看（  ）
options: 三个节日里春节最重要
三个节日里中秋最重要
questions.explanation: 句子用最高级 the most important，范围是三个大节日，说明春节在三个里最重要。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The Mid-Autumn Festival is the most beautiful of the three. Families eat mooncakes.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
questions.explanation: 前半句说中秋在三个节日里最美，后半句说家人吃月饼；粽子是端午的食物，龙舟是端午的活动，句子都没有提到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Spring Festival is the happiest time for children. They get red packets.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 春节是大人最快乐的时候
春节是孩子最快乐的时候
questions.explanation: 句子说春节是孩子们最快乐的时候，还提到孩子拿红包；另一句把对象换成大人，月饼和龙舟是别的节日。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is a high-speed train. It runs about 350 km an hour." 这句话说的是（ ）
options: 一列老式火车每小时约跑 350 公里
一列高铁每小时约跑 350 公里
一座宫殿有 350 年历史
questions.explanation: high-speed train 是高铁，runs about 350 km an hour 说的是它的速度。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Mount Qomolangma in China." 珠穆朗玛峰在哪个国家（ ）
questions.explanation: in China 就是在中国。课本用的是 Mount Qomolangma 这个拼法。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Buckingham Palace in London. It is more than 300 years old." 白金汉宫在哪座城市（ ）
questions.explanation: Buckingham Palace 后面紧跟着 in London，城市就是伦敦。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is an old type of train. It runs about 120 km an hour." 高铁约 350 公里，这种火车比高铁（ ）
questions.explanation: 老式火车每小时约 120 公里，高铁约 350 公里，所以它慢得多。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Mont Blanc in France. It is the highest mountain in Europe." 勃朗峰是哪一洲最高的山（ ）
questions.explanation: the highest mountain in Europe 说的是欧洲最高，不是世界最高。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is the Terracotta Army in Xi'an." 兵马俑在哪座城市（ ）
questions.explanation: in Xi'an 就是西安。兵马俑是西安的，白金汉宫才是伦敦的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Mount Qomolangma in China. It is the highest mountain in the world." 从这句可以知道（ ）
questions.explanation: 珠峰是 the highest in the world，勃朗峰只是 in Europe，所以珠峰更高。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is the Terracotta Army in Xi'an. It is more than 2000 years old." 白金汉宫 300 多年，兵马俑比它（ ）
questions.explanation: 兵马俑 2000 多年，白金汉宫 300 多年，所以兵马俑老得多。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is a high-speed train. It runs about 350 km an hour." 老式火车约 120 公里，高铁比它多跑（ ）
questions.explanation: 350 减 120 等于 230，所以每小时多跑 230 公里。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Mount Qomolangma in China. It is the highest mountain in the world." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 珠峰在中国，是世界最高的山
珠峰在法国，是欧洲最高的山
珠峰在法国，是世界最高的山
珠峰在中国，是欧洲最高的山
questions.explanation: 地点和范围要一起对：in China 配 in the world。欧洲最高的是勃朗峰。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Mont Blanc in France. It is the highest mountain in Europe." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 勃朗峰在英国，是欧洲最高的山
勃朗峰在法国，是欧洲最高的山
勃朗峰在法国，是世界最高的山
勃朗峰在中国，是世界最高的山
questions.explanation: in France 配 in Europe。把 in Europe 读成 in the world 是最常见的错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Buckingham Palace in London. It is more than 300 years old." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 它在西安，有 300 多年历史
它在伦敦，有 2000 多年历史
它在伦敦，有 300 多年历史
它在巴黎，有 300 多年历史
questions.explanation: 城市是伦敦，年数是 300 多。2000 多年的是兵马俑。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is the Terracotta Army in Xi'an. It is more than 2000 years old." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 它在西安，有 300 多年历史
它在西安，有 2000 多年历史
它在伦敦，有 2000 多年历史
它在巴黎，有 2000 多年历史
questions.explanation: in Xi'an 和 more than 2000 years 要一起对上，换掉任何一个都不符。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is a high-speed train. It runs about 350 km an hour." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 高铁每小时约 230 公里
高铁每小时约 470 公里
高铁每小时约 120 公里
高铁每小时约 350 公里
questions.explanation: 350 是高铁的速度。120 是老式火车，230 是两者的差。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is an old type of train. It runs about 120 km an hour." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 老式火车每小时约 470 公里
老式火车每小时约 120 公里
老式火车每小时约 230 公里
老式火车每小时约 350 公里
questions.explanation: old type of train 配 120。350 是高铁，别把两个数字换过来。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Mount Qomolangma in China. It is the highest mountain in the world." 哪一项和这句不符（ ）
questions.explanation: 世界最高和欧洲最高是两个范围。说珠峰是欧洲最高的山，就把它降了一级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is Mont Blanc in France. It is the highest mountain in Europe." 哪一项和这句不符（ ）
options: 勃朗峰是世界最高的山
勃朗峰是欧洲最高的山
questions.explanation: 课文只说它在欧洲最高，没说世界最高。世界最高的是珠峰。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："This is the Terracotta Army in Xi'an. It is more than 2000 years old." 哪一项和这句不符（ ）
options: 兵马俑有 2000 多年历史
questions.explanation: 2000 多年远多于 300 年，说它不到 300 年就把年代缩小了一个数量级。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："We should drink water every day." 这句话建议我们（ ）
questions.explanation: drink water every day 就是每天喝水，should 表示建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Firemen use water to put out fires." 消防员用水做什么（ ）
questions.explanation: put out fires 是灭火。use water to 后面就是水的用途。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Farmers use water to water crops." 农民用水做什么（ ）
questions.explanation: water crops 是浇庄稼。这里的 water 作动词，是浇水的意思。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Almost three quarters of the Earth is water." 地球大约有多少是水（ ）
questions.explanation: three quarters 是四分之三。almost 表示差不多，接近但不完全。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："But we can use or drink only a small part of the water on the Earth." 这句说明（ ）
options: 能用的水只是很少一部分
地球上已经没有一滴水了
水太多了，怎么用也用不完
地球上的水全都能直接喝
questions.explanation: only a small part 是只有很小一部分。but 和上一句的地球多水形成转折。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Take a shower instead of a bath." 这条建议是（ ）
questions.explanation: instead of 是代替，a shower 是淋浴，a bath 是盆浴。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："We use water to wash clothes and take showers. We use water to cook food." 这两句合起来讲（ ）
options: 只有做饭的时候才会用到水
水和洗衣服、做饭都没有关系
水在日常生活中用途很多
水只能用来看，不能用来洗和煮
questions.explanation: 洗衣服、洗澡、做饭都用水，合起来就是水在生活里用途很多。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："We can use or drink only a small part of the water on the Earth." 所以我们应该（ ）
questions.explanation: 能用的水很少，所以课文说 we should not waste water，也就是要节约。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Turn off the dripping tap. Fix a broken tap." 这两条都在说（ ）
questions.explanation: 滴水要关、坏了要修，都是为了不让水白白流掉。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Water is very important in our lives." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 水只用来喝，别的都用不上
水只用来浇花，别的都用不上
水对我们的生活很重要
水对我们的生活一点也不重要
questions.explanation: in our lives 是在我们的生活里，important 是重要。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Animals and plants need water too." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 只有人才需要水，动物不用
只有动物需要水，植物不需要
只有植物需要水，动物不需要
questions.explanation: animals and plants 两个都提了，too 说明人之外它们也需要。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Water the plants with grey water." 这条建议的意思是（ ）
options: 用干净的自来水来浇花
不要给花浇水，让它干着
questions.explanation: grey water 是洗过东西的水，water the plants 是浇花。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Fix a broken tap." 这条建议的意思是（ ）
questions.explanation: fix 是修理，a broken tap 是坏了的水龙头。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Take a shower instead of a bath." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
questions.explanation: 用淋浴代替盆浴，就是因为淋浴用的水少。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："We should drink water every day." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
questions.explanation: every day 是每天，should 是应该。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Water is very important in our lives. We should not waste water." 哪一项和这句不符（ ）
options: 水对我们的生活很重要
questions.explanation: not waste 是不浪费，说可以随便浪费正好相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Almost three quarters of the Earth is water." 哪一项和这句不符（ ）
questions.explanation: 四分之三远远大于零，说没有水就把这句话整个否掉了。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Firemen use water to put out fires." 哪一项和这句不符（ ）
options: 火很大时，消防员用水灭火
questions.explanation: put out fires 是灭火，不是浇庄稼。浇庄稼的是农民。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Dan, his father and his friends are waiting in an underground station." 他们在哪里（ ）
questions.explanation: underground station 是地铁站。waiting in 说明他们正在那里等。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："They are going to take a train to the cinema." 他们要去哪里（ ）
questions.explanation: take a train to the cinema 是坐车去电影院，目的地是电影院。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："An old woman is standing there. She doesn't look well." 那位老妇人怎么样（ ）
questions.explanation: doesn't look well 是看起来不太好，也就是不舒服。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Dan helps her to get on the train and helps her to sit down." Dan 帮老妇人做了什么（ ）
options: 只帮她拿行李，没有扶她上车
让她自己上车，没有扶她
扶她下了火车，送她出站
questions.explanation: get on the train 是上车，sit down 是坐下，两件事都写在句子里。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：Dan says, "I'll take the lady home with my father." Dan 为什么向朋友道歉（ ）
options: 他出门时忘了带钱，买不起票
他要送老妇人回家，不能一起走
他觉得那部电影不好看，所以不想去
他迟到了很久，朋友们已经走了
questions.explanation: take the lady home 是送老人回家，所以他要先离开朋友。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Two days later, he gets a letter and six cinema tickets from the old woman." 两天后 Dan 收到什么（ ）
options: 只有一张电影票和一封信
一封信和一些钱，没有电影票
questions.explanation: a letter 是一封信，six cinema tickets 是六张电影票，数量要看清。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Dan writes his name and address in her notebook." 老妇人为什么要 Dan 写下名字和地址（ ）
questions.explanation: 后文老妇人寄来信和电影票，写信需要地址，所以当时要地址是为了以后联系。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Dan is happy. He can go to the cinema with his friends again!" Dan 为什么高兴（ ）
options: 老妇人搬进了他家，和他住一起
老妇人给了他很多钱作为报答
他又能和朋友一起看电影了
他以后都不用再去电影院了
questions.explanation: again 是关键：他当天没看成，现在有票可以再去一次。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："Dan helps her to get on the train and helps her to sit down." 从这件事能看出 Dan（ ）
questions.explanation: 他主动帮一位不认识的老人，说明他愿意帮助别人。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："It is the weekend in New York." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 故事发生在周一的纽约
故事发生在周末的伦敦
故事发生在暑假的纽约
故事发生在周末的纽约
questions.explanation: weekend 是周末，in New York 是纽约，两个都要对上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子："She lives in a beautiful house." 哪一项和这句相符（ ）
options: 她住在一座漂亮的房子里
她没有家，也没有自己的房子住
她住在车站里，那儿不是房子
她住在 Dan 家，房子不是她的
questions.explanation: lives in 是住在，a beautiful house 是漂亮的房子。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：The old woman asks, "What's your name and address?" 老妇人问的是什么（ ）
questions.explanation: name 是名字，address 是地址，问句里两个词都在。

questions.subject: english
